但这件事本身是可做的，我已经把关键技术面核实了：

- `awesome-design-md` 可以直接作为界面参考源，适合给这个插件补一个明确的 `DESIGN.md` 视觉约束，避免做成通用侧边栏 UI。
- OpenRouter 官方支持 `POST /api/v1/chat/completions`，并支持 `stream: true` 的流式输出。
- NVIDIA NIM / build 的聊天接口也是 OpenAI 兼容的，端点是 `https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1/chat/completions`，同样支持 `stream: true` 和 SSE。
- 如果你当前项目走的是 WPS WebOffice/JSAPI 栈，官方文档已经支持通过 `Range.Text` 读写正文区域，适合做“AI 边生成边写入正文”。

我建议你这个项目最终落成下面这套结构：

- `provider` 抽象一层，只保留 `baseURL / apiKey / model / extraHeaders`。
- UI 里做一个配置面板，支持切换 `OpenRouter` 和 `NVIDIA`，并保存 `apiKey`、`model`、可选 `baseURL`。
- 流式输出不要“每个 token 直接插入光标”，而是先确定一个正文锚点。
  最稳的是选区 `Range`、书签或内容控件。
- AI 返回流时累计成 `buffer`，按 50 到 100ms 节流覆盖 `range.Text = buffer`。
  这样正文是实时刷新的，但不会因为光标漂移、撤销栈混乱或 chunk 乱序而出问题。
- 前端样式可以直接选 `awesome-design-md` 里的一套开发工具风格，比如 `Linear`、`Notion` 或 `Stripe`，适配 WPS 侧边栏窄宽度做成两段式布局：
  上半区是模型/密钥/提示词配置，下半区是会话与“插入正文”状态。

_**Agent (gpt-5.4 2026-04-15 11:18:18Z)**_

你已经查到了，当前这个会话的 Windows 账户就是：

`****\****`

如果你的 IDE 是正常双击启动的，不是“以其他用户身份运行”，那它基本就是用这个账户在跑。`secpol.msc` 也不是在终端里输出内容，它会打开“本地安全策略”窗口，你要在那个窗口里改。

按这个顺序检查：

1. 打开“本地安全策略”窗口后，进入 `本地策略 -> 用户权限分配`
2. 找到 `作为批处理作业登录`
3. 把 `****\****` 加进去
4. 再检查 `拒绝作为批处理作业登录`
5. 确认里面没有 `****\****`，也没有把你覆盖进去的组，比如 `Users`
6. 再检查 `允许本地登录`
7. 确认 `****\****` 或 `Users` 在里面
8. 再检查 `拒绝本地登录`
9. 确认没有这个用户或相关组

改完后执行一次：

```powershell
gpupdate /force
```

然后把当前 IDE 完全退出，再重新打开。最稳的是注销一次 Windows 再登录。

如果你发现：
- “添加用户或组”是灰的
- 你改完又被自动改回去
- 根本找不到可编辑权限

+export function loadStored<T>(key: string, fallback: T): T {
+  if (typeof window === "undefined") {
+    return fallback;
+  }
+
+  try {
+    const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(key);
+    if (!raw) {
+      return fallback;
+    }
+
+    return JSON.parse(raw) as T;
+  } catch {
+    return fallback;
+  }
+}
+
+export function saveStored<T>(key: string, value: T) {
+  if (typeof window === "undefined") {
+    return;
+  }
+
+  try {
+    window.localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(value));
+  } catch {
+    // Ignore quota or serialization errors in the sidebar runtime.
+  }
+}
```

+export function buildUserPrompt(input: {
+  prompt: string;
+  selectionText: string;
+  useSelectionAsContext: boolean;
+}) {
+  const prompt = input.prompt.trim();
+  const selectionText = input.selectionText.trim();
+
+  if (!input.useSelectionAsContext || !selectionText) {
+    return prompt;
+  }
+
+  return [
+    "以下是用户当前在 WPS 文档中选中的内容，请将其作为上下文，不要机械重复原文：",
+    "",
+    "--- 选区开始 ---",
+    selectionText,
+    "--- 选区结束 ---",
+    "",
+    "用户要求：",
+    prompt
+  ].join("\n");
+}

```diff
+export type ProviderId = "openrouter" | "nvidia";
+
+export interface ProviderSettings {
+  providerId: ProviderId;
+  apiKey: string;
+  baseUrl: string;
+  model: string;
+  temperature: number;
+  maxTokens: number;
+  systemPrompt: string;
+  siteUrl: string;
+  siteName: string;
+  useSelectionAsContext: boolean;
+  replaceSelection: boolean;
+}
+
+export interface ChatMessage {
+  role: "system" | "user" | "assistant";
+  content: string;
+}
+
+export interface ChatRequest {
+  settings: ProviderSettings;
+  messages: ChatMessage[];
+  signal?: AbortSignal;
+}
+
+const OPENROUTER_BASE_URL = "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1";
+const NVIDIA_BASE_URL = "https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1";
+
+export const DEFAULT_SETTINGS: ProviderSettings = {
+  providerId: "openrouter",
+  apiKey: "",
+  baseUrl: OPENROUTER_BASE_URL,
+  model: "",
+  temperature: 0.5,
+  maxTokens: 4096,
+  systemPrompt:
+    "你是 WPS 文档助手。输出适合直接写入正式文档正文的中文内容，结构清晰，避免多余寒暄。",
+  siteUrl: import.meta.env.VITE_OPENROUTER_SITE_URL ?? window.location.origin,
+  siteName: import.meta.env.VITE_OPENROUTER_SITE_NAME ?? "WPS AI Task Pane",
+  useSelectionAsContext: true,
+  replaceSelection: true
+};
+
+export const PROVIDER_OPTIONS: Array<{
+  id: ProviderId;
+  label: string;
+  description: string;
+  defaultBaseUrl: string;
+}> = [
+  {
+    id: "openrouter",
+    label: "OpenRouter",
+    description: "OpenAI 兼容接口，适合多模型切换。",
+    defaultBaseUrl: OPENROUTER_BASE_URL
+  },
+  {
+    id: "nvidia",
+    label: "NVIDIA Build",
+    description: "NVIDIA NIM / Build 的 OpenAI 兼容聊天接口。",
+    defaultBaseUrl: NVIDIA_BASE_URL
+  }
+];
+
+export function applyProviderDefaults(
+  current: ProviderSettings,
+  providerId: ProviderId
+): ProviderSettings {
+  const provider = PROVIDER_OPTIONS.find((item) => item.id === providerId);
+  if (!provider) {
+    return current;
+  }
+
+  return {
+    ...current,
+    providerId,
+    baseUrl: provider.defaultBaseUrl
+  };
+}
+
+export function buildRequestInit(input: ChatRequest): RequestInit & { url: string } {
+  const { settings, messages, signal } = input;
+  const baseUrl = settings.baseUrl.trim().replace(/\/+$/, "");
+  const url = `${baseUrl}/chat/completions`;
+
+  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
+    "Content-Type": "application/json",
+    Authorization: `Bearer ${settings.apiKey.trim()}`
+  };
+
+  if (settings.providerId === "openrouter") {
+    headers["HTTP-Referer"] = settings.siteUrl.trim() || window.location.origin;
+    headers["X-Title"] = settings.siteName.trim() || "WPS AI Task Pane";
+  }
+
+  const body = {
+    model: settings.model.trim(),
+    stream: true,
+    temperature: settings.temperature,
+    max_tokens: settings.maxTokens,
+    messages
+  };
+
+  return {
+    url,
+    method: "POST",
+    headers,
+    body: JSON.stringify(body),
+    signal
+  };
+}
```

**Add: `rebuild-wps-ai/src/lib/sse.ts`**

```diff
+import { buildRequestInit, type ChatRequest } from "./providers";
+
+function normalizeContent(content: unknown): string {
+  if (typeof content === "string") {
+    return content;
+  }
+
+  if (!Array.isArray(content)) {
+    return "";
+  }
+
+  return content
+    .map((item) => {
+      if (typeof item === "string") {
+        return item;
+      }
+
+      if (item && typeof item === "object" && "text" in item) {
+        return String(item.text ?? "");
+      }
+
+      return "";
+    })
+    .join("");
+}
+
+function extractTextChunk(payload: any): string {
+  const choice = payload?.choices?.[0];
+  if (!choice) {
+    return "";
+  }
+
+  return (
+    normalizeContent(choice.delta?.content) ||
+    normalizeContent(choice.message?.content) ||
+    ""
+  );
+}
+
+async function parseJsonError(response: Response) {
+  const contentType = response.headers.get("content-type") ?? "";
+
+  try {
+    if (contentType.includes("application/json")) {
+      const json = await response.json();
+      return json?.error?.message ?? JSON.stringify(json);
+    }
+
+    return await response.text();
+  } catch {
+    return `${response.status} ${response.statusText}`;
+  }
+}
+
+export async function* streamChatText(input: ChatRequest): AsyncGenerator<string> {
+  const request = buildRequestInit(input);
+  const response = await fetch(request.url, request);
+
+  if (!response.ok) {
+    const detail = await parseJsonError(response);
+    throw new Error(detail || `${response.status} ${response.statusText}`);
+  }
+
+  const contentType = response.headers.get("content-type") ?? "";
+
+  if (!response.body || !contentType.includes("text/event-stream")) {
+    const json = await response.json();
+    const text = extractTextChunk(json);
+    if (text) {
+      yield text;
+    }
+    return;
+  }
+
+  const reader = response.body.getReader();
+  const decoder = new TextDecoder();
+  let buffer = "";
+
+  while (true) {
+    const { value, done } = await reader.read();
+
+    if (done) {
+      buffer += decoder.decode();
+      break;
+    }
+
+    buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
+
+    const segments = buffer.split(/\r?\n\r?\n/);
+    buffer = segments.pop() ?? "";
+
+    for (const segment of segments) {
+      const data = segment
+        .split(/\r?\n/)
+        .filter((line) => line.startsWith("data:"))
+        .map((line) => line.slice(5).trimStart())
+        .join("\n");
+
+      if (!data || data === "[DONE]") {
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      const payload = JSON.parse(data);
+      const text = extractTextChunk(payload);
+      if (text) {
+        yield text;
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  if (buffer.trim()) {
+    const lines = buffer
+      .split(/\r?\n/)
+      .filter((line) => line.startsWith("data:"))
+      .map((line) => line.slice(5).trimStart());
+
+    for (const line of lines) {
+      if (!line || line === "[DONE]") {
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      const payload = JSON.parse(line);
+      const text = extractTextChunk(payload);
+      if (text) {
+        yield text;
+      }
+    }
+  }
+}
```

**Add: `rebuild-wps-ai/src/lib/wps.ts`**

```diff
+type MaybePromise<T> = T | Promise<T>;
+
+async function maybe<T>(value: MaybePromise<T>): Promise<T> {
+  return await value;
+}
+
+function isWebOfficeHost() {
+  return Boolean(window.instance?.ready && window.instance?.Application);
+}
+
+function isLocalWpsHost() {
+  return Boolean(window.wps?.Application || window.Application);
+}
+
+async function getApplication() {
+  if (isWebOfficeHost()) {
+    await window.instance!.ready();
+    return window.instance!.Application;
+  }
+
+  return window.wps?.Application ?? window.Application ?? null;
+}
+
+async function getSelectionRange(app: any) {
+  const selection = await maybe(app.ActiveDocument.ActiveWindow.Selection);
+  return await maybe(selection.Range);
+}
+
+async function getSelectionText(app: any) {
+  const range = await getSelectionRange(app);
+  return String((await maybe(range.Text)) ?? "");
+}
+
+export interface StreamingWriter {
+  update: (text: string) => Promise<void>;
+  finish: () => Promise<void>;
+  cancel: () => Promise<void>;
+  locationLabel: string;
+}
+
+export interface WpsBridge {
+  kind: "weboffice" | "wps" | "mock";
+  label: string;
+  readSelectionText: () => Promise<string>;
+  createStreamingWriter: (options: { replaceSelection: boolean }) => Promise<StreamingWriter>;
+}
+
+class MockBridge implements WpsBridge {
+  kind = "mock" as const;
+  label = "Browser Preview";
+
+  async readSelectionText() {
+    return "";
+  }
+
+  async createStreamingWriter() {
+    return {
+      locationLabel: "未检测到 WPS Host，仅在侧边栏预览",
+      update: async () => undefined,
+      finish: async () => undefined,
+      cancel: async () => undefined
+    };
+  }
+}
+
+class RuntimeWpsBridge implements WpsBridge {
+  constructor(
+    public kind: "weboffice" | "wps",
+    public label: string
+  ) {}
+
+  async readSelectionText() {
+    const app = await getApplication();
+    if (!app) {
+      return "";
+    }
+
+    return await getSelectionText(app);
+  }
+
+  async createStreamingWriter(options: { replaceSelection: boolean }) {
+    const app = await getApplication();
+    if (!app) {
+      throw new Error("当前页面未检测到可写入的 WPS 文档实例。");
+    }
+
+    const selectionRange = await getSelectionRange(app);
+    const start = Number(await maybe(selectionRange.Start));
+    const end = Number(await maybe(selectionRange.End));
+    const originalText = String((await maybe(selectionRange.Text)) ?? "");
+    const anchor = start;
+    let latestText = "";
+    let queuedText = "";
+    let flushTimer: number | null = null;
+    let isFlushing = false;
+
+    if (options.replaceSelection && end > start) {
+      selectionRange.Text = "";
+    }
+
+    const flush = async () => {
+      if (isFlushing) {
+        return;
+      }
+
+      isFlushing = true;
+
+      try {
+        if (latestText === queuedText) {
+          return;
+        }
+
+        latestText = queuedText;
+        const range = await maybe(
+          app.ActiveDocument.Range(anchor, anchor + latestText.length)
+        );
+        range.Text = latestText;
+      } finally {
+        isFlushing = false;
+      }
+    };
+
+    const scheduleFlush = async () => {
+      if (flushTimer !== null) {
+        return;
+      }
+
+      flushTimer = window.setTimeout(async () => {
+        flushTimer = null;
+        await flush();
+      }, 60);
+    };
+
+    return {
+      locationLabel: options.replaceSelection
+        ? "实时覆盖当前选区"
+        : "实时插入到当前光标位置",
+      update: async (text: string) => {
+        queuedText = text;
+        await scheduleFlush();
+      },
+      finish: async () => {
+        if (flushTimer !== null) {
+          window.clearTimeout(flushTimer);
+          flushTimer = null;
+        }
+
+        await flush();
+      },
+      cancel: async () => {
+        if (flushTimer !== null) {
+          window.clearTimeout(flushTimer);
+          flushTimer = null;
+        }
+
+        if (!latestText && options.replaceSelection && originalText) {
+          const restoreRange = await maybe(app.ActiveDocument.Range(anchor, anchor));
+          restoreRange.Text = originalText;
+        }
+      }
+    };
+  }
+}
+
+export async function detectWpsBridge(): Promise<WpsBridge> {
+  if (isWebOfficeHost()) {
+    return new RuntimeWpsBridge("weboffice", "WPS WebOffice");
+  }
+
+  if (isLocalWpsHost()) {
+    return new RuntimeWpsBridge("wps", "WPS 本地宿主");
+  }
+
+  return new MockBridge();
+}
```

```diff
+import {
+  startTransition,
+  useEffect,
+  useMemo,
+  useRef,
+  useState
+} from "react";
+import {
+  DEFAULT_SETTINGS,
+  PROVIDER_OPTIONS,
+  applyProviderDefaults,
+  type ProviderId,
+  type ProviderSettings
+} from "./lib/providers";
+import { buildUserPrompt } from "./lib/prompt";
+import { streamChatText } from "./lib/sse";
+import { loadStored, saveStored } from "./lib/storage";
+import { detectWpsBridge, type StreamingWriter, type WpsBridge } from "./lib/wps";
+
+const SETTINGS_KEY = "rebuild-wps-ai.settings";
+const PROMPT_KEY = "rebuild-wps-ai.prompt";
+
+export default function App() {
+  const [settings, setSettings] = useState<ProviderSettings>(() =>
+    loadStored(SETTINGS_KEY, DEFAULT_SETTINGS)
+  );
+  const [prompt, setPrompt] = useState(() =>
+    loadStored(
+      PROMPT_KEY,
+      "请根据当前主题生成适合直接写入正式文档正文的内容。"
+    )
+  );
+  const [selectionPreview, setSelectionPreview] = useState("");
+  const [output, setOutput] = useState("");
+  const [hostLabel, setHostLabel] = useState("检测中");
+  const [docStatus, setDocStatus] = useState("等待连接");
+  const [error, setError] = useState("");
+  const [isGenerating, setIsGenerating] = useState(false);
+
+  const bridgeRef = useRef<WpsBridge | null>(null);
+  const writerRef = useRef<StreamingWriter | null>(null);
+  const abortRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    saveStored(SETTINGS_KEY, settings);
+  }, [settings]);
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    saveStored(PROMPT_KEY, prompt);
+  }, [prompt]);
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    let mounted = true;
+
+    async function bootstrap() {
+      const bridge = await detectWpsBridge();
+      if (!mounted) {
+        return;
+      }
+
+      bridgeRef.current = bridge;
+      setHostLabel(bridge.label);
+
+      if (bridge.kind === "mock") {
+        setDocStatus("当前仅侧边栏预览，未连接 WPS 文档宿主");
+        return;
+      }
+
+      setDocStatus("已连接文档宿主，可实时写入正文");
+
+      try {
+        const selected = await bridge.readSelectionText();
+        if (mounted) {
+          setSelectionPreview(selected);
+        }
+      } catch {
+        if (mounted) {
+          setDocStatus("宿主已连接，但暂时无法读取当前选区");
+        }
+      }
+    }
+
+    void bootstrap();
+
+    return () => {
+      mounted = false;
+    };
+  }, []);
+
+  const providerMeta = useMemo(
+    () =>
+      PROVIDER_OPTIONS.find((item) => item.id === settings.providerId) ??
+      PROVIDER_OPTIONS[0],
+    [settings.providerId]
+  );
+
+  async function refreshSelection() {
+    const bridge = bridgeRef.current ?? (await detectWpsBridge());
+    bridgeRef.current = bridge;
+    setHostLabel(bridge.label);
+
+    try {
+      const text = await bridge.readSelectionText();
+      setSelectionPreview(text);
+      setDocStatus(
+        text ? "已同步当前选区内容" : "当前选区为空，将按光标位置写入正文"
+      );
+    } catch (caught) {
+      const message =
+        caught instanceof Error ? caught.message : "读取选区失败";
+      setError(message);
+    }
+  }
+
+  function updateSettings<K extends keyof ProviderSettings>(
+    key: K,
+    value: ProviderSettings[K]
+  ) {
+    setSettings((current) => ({ ...current, [key]: value }));
+  }
+
+  function onProviderChange(value: ProviderId) {
+    setSettings((current) => applyProviderDefaults(current, value));
+  }
+
+  async function stopGeneration() {
+    abortRef.current?.abort();
+    abortRef.current = null;
+    setIsGenerating(false);
+    setDocStatus("已停止生成");
+  }
+
+  async function handleGenerate() {
+    const trimmedPrompt = prompt.trim();
+    if (!settings.apiKey.trim()) {
+      setError("请先填写 API Key。");
+      return;
+    }
+
+    if (!settings.model.trim()) {
+      setError("请先填写模型 ID。");
+      return;
+    }
+
+    if (!trimmedPrompt) {
+      setError("请输入任务要求。");
+      return;
+    }
+
+    setError("");
+    setOutput("");
+    setIsGenerating(true);
+
+    const bridge = bridgeRef.current ?? (await detectWpsBridge());
+    bridgeRef.current = bridge;
+    setHostLabel(bridge.label);
+
+    let currentSelection = selectionPreview;
+    if (settings.useSelectionAsContext && !currentSelection) {
+      try {
+        currentSelection = await bridge.readSelectionText();
+        setSelectionPreview(currentSelection);
+      } catch {
+        currentSelection = "";
+      }
+    }
+
+    const writer = await bridge.createStreamingWriter({
+      replaceSelection: settings.replaceSelection
+    });
+    writerRef.current = writer;
+    setDocStatus(writer.locationLabel);
+
+    const controller = new AbortController();
+    abortRef.current = controller;
+
+    try {
+      const messages = [
+        {
+          role: "system" as const,
+          content: settings.systemPrompt.trim()
+        },
+        {
+          role: "user" as const,
+          content: buildUserPrompt({
+            prompt: trimmedPrompt,
+            selectionText: currentSelection,
+            useSelectionAsContext: settings.useSelectionAsContext
+          })
+        }
+      ];
+
+      let fullText = "";
+
+      for await (const chunk of streamChatText({
+        settings,
+        messages,
+        signal: controller.signal
+      })) {
+        fullText += chunk;
+        await writer.update(fullText);
+        startTransition(() => {
+          setOutput(fullText);
+        });
+      }
+
+      await writer.finish();
+      setDocStatus(
+        bridge.kind === "mock"
+          ? "本次生成仅在侧边栏预览"
+          : "内容已实时写入 WPS 正文"
+      );
+    } catch (caught) {
+      const isAbort =
+        caught instanceof DOMException && caught.name === "AbortError";
+      if (isAbort) {
+        await writer.cancel();
+        setDocStatus("已停止，保留当前已写入内容");
+      } else {
+        const message =
+          caught instanceof Error ? caught.message : "生成失败";
+        setError(message);
+        setDocStatus("生成失败");
+      }
+    } finally {
+      abortRef.current = null;
+      writerRef.current = null;
+      setIsGenerating(false);
+    }
+  }

+                rows={9}

**Add: `rebuild-wps-ai/README.md`**

```diff
+# WPS AI 重构版
+
+这是一个独立重建的 WPS 侧边栏项目，目标是直接满足这三个需求：
+
+- 在 WPS 中作为任务窗格使用
+- 可切换 `OpenRouter` 或 `NVIDIA Build` 的 OpenAI 兼容接口
+- 模型输出流式实时写入 WPS 正文
+
+## 目录
+
+- `src/lib/providers.ts`
+  Provider 抽象和默认配置
+- `src/lib/sse.ts`
+  SSE 流式解析和 OpenAI 兼容输出提取
+- `src/lib/wps.ts`
+  WPS 文档桥接。优先探测 `window.instance` 的 WebOffice 宿主，其次探测 `window.wps.Application` 或 `window.Application`
+- `src/App.tsx`
+  侧边栏 UI、设置面板、流式写入流程
+
+## 启动
+
+```bash
+npm install
+npm run dev
+```
+
+## 构建
+
+```bash
+npm run build
+```
+
+构建产物可以直接作为任务窗格页面部署。
+
+## 宿主接入
+
+### WPS WebOffice
+
+如果你是 WebOffice 页面集成，初始化实例后把实例暴露给任务窗格页面：
+
+```ts
+const instance = WebOfficeSDK.init(config)
+window.instance = instance
+```
+
+项目会自动调用：
+
+- `instance.ready()`
+- `instance.Application`
+- `ActiveDocument.ActiveWindow.Selection.Range`
+- `Range.Text`
+
+### WPS 本地宿主
+
+如果你已有本地宿主桥接，请确保页面内能访问下面任一对象：
+
+```ts
+window.wps.Application
+window.Application
+```
+
+项目会在运行时自动探测，并使用相同的 Range 写入逻辑。
+
+## 写入策略
+
+为了保证“实时输出到正文”时不因为 token 频繁刷新导致光标漂移，这个实现采用了固定锚点策略：
+
+1. 记录当前选区 `Start/End`
+2. 可选清空原选区
+3. 模型流式返回时，按 60ms 节流
+4. 每次用 `ActiveDocument.Range(anchor, anchor + text.length).Text = text` 覆写该段区域
+
+这样正文能持续刷新，同时比逐 token 调一次插入 API 更稳定。
+
+## Provider 配置
+
+### OpenRouter
+
+- Base URL 默认：`https://openrouter.ai/api/v1`
+- 需要 `API Key`
+- 支持附加 `HTTP-Referer` 和 `X-Title`
+
+### NVIDIA Build
+
+- Base URL 默认：`https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1`
+- 需要 `API Key`
+- 模型 ID 请填你账号已开通的模型
+
+## 已知前提
+
+- 当前实现按 OpenAI 兼容 `/chat/completions` 和 `stream: true` 发送请求
+- 侧边栏本身可以脱离 WPS 宿主启动；如果未探测到宿主，将退化成仅预览模式
+- 由于当前会话无法读取旧仓库，这一版是新增的完整替代实现，不会主动覆盖原有文件
```

# SpecStory Artifacts Directory
    
This directory is automatically created and maintained by the SpecStory extension to preserve your AI chat history.
    
## What's Here?
    
- `.specstory/history`: Contains auto-saved markdown files of your AI coding sessions
    - Each file represents a separate AI chat session
    - If you enable auto-save, files are automatically updated as you work
    - You can enable/disable the auto-save feature in the SpecStory settings, it is disabled by default
- `.specstory/.project.json`: Contains the persistent project identity for the current workspace
    - This file is only present if you enable AI rules derivation
    - This is used to provide consistent project identity of your project, even as the workspace is moved or renamed
- `.specstory/ai_rules_backups`: Contains backups of the `.cursor/rules/derived-cursor-rules.mdc` or the `.github/copilot-instructions.md` file
    - Backups are automatically created each time the `.cursor/rules/derived-cursor-rules.mdc` or the `.github/copilot-instructions.md` file is updated
    - You can enable/disable the AI Rules derivation feature in the SpecStory settings, it is disabled by default
- `.specstory/.gitignore`: Contains directives to exclude non-essential contents of the `.specstory` directory from version control
    - Add `/history` to exclude the auto-saved chat history from version control

## Valuable Uses
    
- Capture: Keep your context window up-to-date when starting new Chat/Composer sessions via @ references
- Search: For previous prompts and code snippets 
- Learn: Meta-analyze your patterns and learn from your past experiences
- Derive: Keep the AI on course with your past decisions by automatically deriving rules from your AI interactions
    
## Version Control
    
We recommend keeping this directory under version control to maintain a history of your AI interactions. However, if you prefer not to version these files, you can exclude them by adding this to your `.gitignore`:
    
```
.specstory/**
```

We recommend __not__ keeping the `.specstory/ai_rules_backups` directory under version control if you are already using git to version your AI rules, and committing regularly. You can exclude it by adding this to your `.gitignore`:

```
.specstory/ai_rules_backups
```

## Searching Your Codebase
    
When searching your codebase, search results may include your previous AI coding interactions. To focus solely on your actual code files, you can exclude the AI interaction history from search results.
    
To exclude AI interaction history:
    
1. Open the "Find in Files" search in Cursor or VSCode (Cmd/Ctrl + Shift + F)
2. Navigate to the "files to exclude" section
3. Add the following pattern:
    
```
.specstory/*
```
    
This will ensure your searches only return results from your working codebase files.

## Notes

- Auto-save only works when Cursor or VSCode flushes sqlite database data to disk. This results in a small delay after the AI response is complete before SpecStory can save the history.

## Settings
    
You can control auto-saving behavior in Cursor or VSCode:
    
1. Open Cursor/Code 鈫?Settings 鈫?VS Code Settings (Cmd/Ctrl + ,)
2. Search for "SpecStory"
3. Find "Auto Save" setting to enable/disable
    
Auto-save occurs when changes are detected in the sqlite database, or every 2 minutes as a safety net.

# wpsjs README

用于开发wps加载项的工具，让开发wps加载项更容易一点。提供：
* 快速创建 WPS 加载项项目，可以指定加载项单独用于文字/演示/电子表格，指定开发UI框架，目前提供原生/Vue/React三种选择
* 调试 WPS 加载项，在加载项目录执行 wpsjs debug 即可自动启动 WPS 客户端，查看加载项的效果
* 生成 WPS 加载项部署页面，通过该网页可以查看当前环境下所有的 WPS 加载项信息，并能对加载项进行安装/卸载/更新操作


# 版本改动
- v2.2.3:
修复无框架加载项打包时ribbon.xml文件缺少问题
- v2.2.2:
修复typescript依赖库没有被安装的问题, 修复vue和react框架下, 自定义函数被多个页面重复注册的问题
- v2.2.1:
添加加载项自定义函数的功能。表格加载项模板中添加自定义函数的示例代码。
* v2.2.0:
增加Mac适配代码
* v2.1.8:
增加PC鸿蒙平台适配代码
* v2.1.7:
添加配置项customDomain，使用该配置可以将离线加载项的本地文件模拟成自定义域名下的在线文件，该配置目前只对鸿蒙版本的WPS生效
配置customDomain方式：在需要发布的加载项的package.json文件中添加字段，例如"customDomain": "local.wps.com"。
* v2.1.6:
修复vue框架下，在线部署会出现404的问题
* v2.1.3:
修复在无框架模式下，通过npm build --exe会失败的问题
* v2.1.2:
引入ts类型描述文件，支持代码提示
* v1.5.9:
支持通过wpsjs build --exe, 在win平台上将项目打包成exe文件，方便分发
* v1.5.8:
处理ribbon对象偶尔找不到的问题，处理wpsjs build的问题
* v1.5.5:
处理wpsjs debug在企业版失败的问题
* v1.5.4:
wpsjs create创建的示例工程支持vue3, node版本支持到V20.15
* v1.5.2:
支持wps个人版客户端自12.1.0.16910版本之后的wpsjs debug调试
* v1.4.5:
使用wpsjs-rpc-sdk包中的jssdk，去掉重复的文件
* v1.4.6:
修复linux下debug失败问题
* v1.4.7:
支持多用户，兼容老版本
* v1.4.8:
publish模式认证优化
* v1.4.9:
publish模式默认关闭多用户模式，后续有需求再修改wpsjs工具
* v1.4.10:
ribbon.js去掉js接口toLocaleDateString()和toLocaleTimeString()，解决linux环境下调用该接口报错的问题；
systemdemo.html获取文件路径的方式改一下，解决url含目录时，获取文件路径错误的问题；
publish.html兼容没有安全提示的版本；
* v1.4.11:
publish.html增加判断条件，只有同时满足加载项服务版本大于等于1.0.2而且开启了多用户，请求才带上serverID
* v1.4.12:
统一流程，sdk返回的状态码result.status !== 0时，代表操作执行失败，然后判断客户端是否退出；执行成功后的逻辑统一放到result.status == 0下；
result.status !== 0，sdk返回的消息在result.message里；result.status == 0时，sdk返回的消息在result.response里；
publish模式支持多用户

async function create(projectName, options) {

		console.log(`${chalk.red("椤圭洰鍚嶅彧鑳芥槸瀛楁瘝銆佹暟瀛楀拰涓嬪垝绾?)}...`)
		return
	}
	const cwd = options.cwd || process.cwd()
	const targetDir = path.resolve(cwd, projectName || '.')
	if (fs.existsSync(targetDir)) {
		const { action } = await inquirer.prompt([
			{
				name: 'action',
				type: 'list',
				message: `鐩爣鏂囦欢澶?${chalk.cyan(targetDir)} 宸茬粡瀛樺湪銆傝閫夋嫨鎿嶄綔:`,
				choices: [
					{ name: '鍒犻櫎', value: 'overwrite' },
					{ name: '鍙栨秷', value: false }
				]
			}
		])
		if (!action)
			return false
		console.log(`\n鍒犻櫎鐩綍 ${chalk.cyan(targetDir)}...`)
		fsEx.removeSync(targetDir)
	}
	inquirer.prompt([{
		name: 'pluginType',
		type: 'list',
		message: `閫夋嫨 WPS 鍔犺浇椤圭被鍨?`,
		choices: [
			{
				name: '鏂囧瓧',
				value: 'wps'
			},
			{
				name: '婕旂ず',
				value: 'wpp'
			},
			{
				name: '鐢靛瓙琛ㄦ牸',
				value: 'et'
			}
		]
	}, {
		name: 'frameType',
		type: 'list',
		message: `閫夋嫨UI妗嗘灦:`,
		choices: [
			{
				name: 'Vue(鎺ㄨ崘)',
				value: 'vue'
			},
			{
				name: 'React',
				value: 'react'
			},
			{
				name: '鏃?,
				value: 'none'
			}
		]
	}]).then(answers => {
		context = targetDir
		let demoType = answers.pluginType
		if (answers.frameType != "none")
			demoType = `${answers.pluginType}_${answers.frameType}`
		const pluginPath = path.resolve(pluginsDirPath, demoType)
		fs.readdir(pluginPath, (_, files) => {
			files.forEach(file => {
				const srcPath = path.resolve(pluginPath, file)
				const dstPath = path.resolve(targetDir, file)
				fsEx.copySync(srcPath, dstPath)
			})

			const cfgPath = path.resolve(targetDir, 'package.json')
			var cfgData = fsEx.readFileSync(cfgPath)
			var oldCfg = JSON.parse(cfgData)

			var projectCfg = { name: projectName, addonType: answers.pluginType, version: "1.0.0" }
			for (key in oldCfg)
				projectCfg[key] = oldCfg[key]
			projectCfg.name = projectName
			projectCfg.addonType = answers.pluginType
			projectCfg.version = "1.0.0"
			cfgData = JSON.stringify(projectCfg, "", "\t")
			fsEx.writeFileSync(cfgPath, cfgData)

			initAddOn(targetDir, projectName, answers)
		})
	})
}

async function initAddOn(targetDir, projectName, answers) {
	if (jsUtil.hasGit()) {
		await run('git init')
		await run('git add -A')
		await run('git', ['commit', '-m', 'init'])
	}

	if (os.platform()=='win32'){
		cp.spawnSync('cmd', ['/c', 'npm', 'i'], { stdio: 'inherit', cwd: targetDir })
	}else{
		cp.spawnSync(jsUtil.GetNpmCmd(), ['i'], { stdio: 'inherit', cwd: targetDir })
	}

	console.log(
		`\n==>>  鎵ц浠ヤ笅鍛戒护杩涜 WPS 鍔犺浇椤瑰紑鍙?\n\n` +
		(chalk.cyan(` ${chalk.gray('$')} cd ${projectName}\n`)) +
		chalk.cyan(` ${chalk.gray('$')} wpsjs debug\n`)
	)
}

function run(command, args) {
	if (!args) { [command, ...args] = command.split(/\s+/) }
	return execa(command, args, { cwd: context })
}

module.exports = (...args) => {
	return create(...args).catch(err => {
		console.error(err)
		if (!process.env.VUE_CLI_TEST) {
			process.exit(1)
		}
	})
}

            }
        case ADDSTRING:
            {
                let doc = window.Application.ActiveDocument
                if (doc){
                    doc.Range(0, 0).Text="Hello, wps鍔犺浇椤?"
                    //濂藉儚鏄痺ps鐨刡ug, 杩欎袱鍙ヨ瘽瑙﹀彂wps閲嶇粯
                    let rgSel = window.Application.Selection.Range
                    if (rgSel)
                        rgSel.Select()
                }
                break;
            }
        case GETDOCNAME:
            {
                let docName = window.Application.ActiveDocument.Name
                let newState = state.set('docName', docName)
                return newState
            }
        case SETDEMOSPAN:
            {
                let newState = state.set('DemoSpan', action.data)
                return newState
            }
        case OPENWEB:
            {
                let param = state.get('demoSpan')
                window.Application.OAAssist.ShellExecute(param)
            }
        default:
    }
    return state;
}

+const STORAGE_KEY = "wps_ai_taskpane_id";
+
+function getDockRightValue() {
+  if (window.Application?.Enum?.msoCTPDockPositionRight !== undefined) {
+    return window.Application.Enum.msoCTPDockPositionRight;
+  }
+
+  return 2;
+}
+
+function getTaskPaneUrl() {
+  return new URL("./taskpane.html", window.location.href).href;
+}
+
+function ensureTaskPane() {
+  const storage = window.Application.PluginStorage;
+  const existingId = storage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
+
+  if (existingId) {
+    const existing = window.Application.GetTaskPane(existingId);
+    if (existing) {
+      return existing;
+    }
+  }
+
+  const taskPane = window.Application.CreateTaskPane(getTaskPaneUrl());
+  storage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, taskPane.ID);
+  taskPane.DockPosition = getDockRightValue();
+  return taskPane;
+}
+
+const ribbon = {
+  OnAddinLoad(ribbonUI) {
+    if (typeof window.Application.ribbonUI !== "object") {
+      window.Application.ribbonUI = ribbonUI;
+    }
+
+    return true;
+  },
+
+  OnAction(control) {
+    const doc = window.Application?.ActiveDocument;
+    if (!doc) {
+      alert("当前没有打开任何文字文档。");
+      return true;
+    }
+
+    const taskPane = ensureTaskPane();
+
+    switch (control.Id) {
+      case "btnToggleTaskPane":
+        taskPane.Visible = !taskPane.Visible;
+        break;
+      case "btnFocusTaskPane":
+        taskPane.Visible = true;
+        break;
+      default:
+        break;
+    }
+
+    return true;
+  },
+
+  GetImage(control) {
+    if (control.Id === "btnFocusTaskPane") {
+      return "images/ai-stream.svg";
+    }
+
+    return "images/ai-pane.svg";
+  },
+
+  OnGetEnabled() {
+    return Boolean(window.Application?.ActiveDocument);
+  }
+};
+
+export default ribbon;

+const SETTINGS_KEY = "wps-ai.settings";
+const PROMPT_KEY = "wps-ai.prompt";
+
+export function loadStoredValue(key, fallbackValue) {
+  try {
+    const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(key);
+    return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : fallbackValue;
+  } catch {
+    return fallbackValue;
+  }
+}
+
+export function saveStoredValue(key, value) {
+  try {
+    window.localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(value));
+  } catch {
+    // Ignore local storage failures in host environments with tighter quotas.
+  }
+}
+
+export { SETTINGS_KEY, PROMPT_KEY };

```diff
+export const PROVIDERS = {
+  openrouter: {
+    id: "openrouter",
+    label: "OpenRouter",
+    defaultBaseUrl: "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1",
+    placeholderModel: "openai/gpt-4.1-mini"
+  },
+  nvidia: {
+    id: "nvidia",
+    label: "NVIDIA Build",
+    defaultBaseUrl: "https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1",
+    placeholderModel: "meta/llama-3.1-70b-instruct"
+  }
+};
+
+export const DEFAULT_SETTINGS = {
+  providerId: "openrouter",
+  baseUrl: PROVIDERS.openrouter.defaultBaseUrl,
+  apiKey: "",
+  model: "",
+  temperature: 0.5,
+  maxTokens: 4096,
+  systemPrompt:
+    "你是 WPS 文档助手。请输出适合直接写入正式文档正文的中文内容，结构清晰，避免寒暄和元叙述。",
+  referer: "https://localhost",
+  title: "WPS AI Plugin",
+  useSelectionAsContext: true,
+  replaceSelection: true
+};
+
+function normalizeContent(content) {
+  if (typeof content === "string") {
+    return content;
+  }
+
+  if (!Array.isArray(content)) {
+    return "";
+  }
+
+  return content
+    .map((item) => {
+      if (typeof item === "string") {
+        return item;
+      }
+
+      if (item && typeof item === "object" && "text" in item) {
+        return String(item.text ?? "");
+      }
+
+      return "";
+    })
+    .join("");
+}
+
+function extractChunk(payload) {
+  const choice = payload?.choices?.[0];
+  if (!choice) {
+    return "";
+  }
+
+  return (
+    normalizeContent(choice.delta?.content) ||
+    normalizeContent(choice.message?.content) ||
+    ""
+  );
+}
+
+async function buildError(response) {
+  const contentType = response.headers.get("content-type") ?? "";
+
+  try {
+    if (contentType.includes("application/json")) {
+      const json = await response.json();
+      return json?.error?.message || JSON.stringify(json);
+    }
+
+    return await response.text();
+  } catch {
+    return `${response.status} ${response.statusText}`;
+  }
+}
+
+export function buildMessages({ prompt, selectionText, settings }) {
+  const selectionBlock =
+    settings.useSelectionAsContext && selectionText.trim()
+      ? [
+          "以下内容是用户当前在 WPS 文档中选中的正文，请将其作为上下文，不要机械重复：",
+          "",
+          "---- 选区开始 ----",
+          selectionText.trim(),
+          "---- 选区结束 ----",
+          ""
+        ].join("\n")
+      : "";
+
+  return [
+    {
+      role: "system",
+      content: settings.systemPrompt.trim()
+    },
+    {
+      role: "user",
+      content: `${selectionBlock}${prompt.trim()}`
+    }
+  ];
+}
+
+export async function* streamCompletion({ settings, messages, signal }) {
+  const headers = {
+    "Content-Type": "application/json",
+    Authorization: `Bearer ${settings.apiKey.trim()}`
+  };
+
+  if (settings.providerId === "openrouter") {
+    headers["HTTP-Referer"] = settings.referer.trim() || "https://localhost";
+    headers["X-Title"] = settings.title.trim() || "WPS AI Plugin";
+  }
+
+  const response = await fetch(
+    `${settings.baseUrl.replace(/\/+$/, "")}/chat/completions`,
+    {
+      method: "POST",
+      headers,
+      body: JSON.stringify({
+        model: settings.model.trim(),
+        messages,
+        temperature: Number(settings.temperature),
+        max_tokens: Number(settings.maxTokens),
+        stream: true
+      }),
+      signal
+    }
+  );
+
+  if (!response.ok) {
+    throw new Error(await buildError(response));
+  }
+
+  if (!response.body) {
+    const json = await response.json();
+    const fallbackText = extractChunk(json);
+    if (fallbackText) {
+      yield fallbackText;
+    }
+    return;
+  }
+
+  const contentType = response.headers.get("content-type") ?? "";
+  if (!contentType.includes("text/event-stream")) {
+    const json = await response.json();
+    const fallbackText = extractChunk(json);
+    if (fallbackText) {
+      yield fallbackText;
+    }
+    return;
+  }
+
+  const reader = response.body.getReader();
+  const decoder = new TextDecoder();
+  let buffer = "";
+
+  while (true) {
+    const { value, done } = await reader.read();
+
+    if (done) {
+      buffer += decoder.decode();
+      break;
+    }
+
+    buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
+    const parts = buffer.split(/\r?\n\r?\n/);
+    buffer = parts.pop() ?? "";
+
+    for (const part of parts) {
+      const lines = part
+        .split(/\r?\n/)
+        .filter((line) => line.startsWith("data:"))
+        .map((line) => line.slice(5).trim());
+
+      for (const line of lines) {
+        if (!line || line === "[DONE]") {
+          continue;
+        }
+
+        const payload = JSON.parse(line);
+        const text = extractChunk(payload);
+        if (text) {
+          yield text;
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  if (!buffer.trim()) {
+    return;
+  }
+
+  const lines = buffer
+    .split(/\r?\n/)
+    .filter((line) => line.startsWith("data:"))
+    .map((line) => line.slice(5).trim());
+
+  for (const line of lines) {
+    if (!line || line === "[DONE]") {
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const payload = JSON.parse(line);
+    const text = extractChunk(payload);
+    if (text) {
+      yield text;
+    }
+  }
+}
```

```diff
+function getApplication() {
+  if (window.Application) {
+    return window.Application;
+  }
+
+  if (window.wps?.Application) {
+    return window.wps.Application;
+  }
+
+  if (window.instance?.Application) {
+    return window.instance.Application;
+  }
+
+  return null;
+}
+
+function getSelectionRange(app) {
+  return app.Selection?.Range || app.ActiveDocument?.ActiveWindow?.Selection?.Range || null;
+}
+
+function forceRefresh(range) {
+  try {
+    if (range && typeof range.Select === "function") {
+      range.Select();
+    }
+  } catch {
+    // Ignore redraw issues on hosts that do not support Select.
+  }
+}
+
+export function detectHostLabel() {
+  if (window.Application) {
+    return "WPS 本地插件";
+  }
+
+  if (window.wps?.Application) {
+    return "WPS 宿主";
+  }
+
+  if (window.instance?.Application) {
+    return "WebOffice 宿主";
+  }
+
+  return "浏览器预览";
+}
+
+export function readSelectionText() {
+  const app = getApplication();
+  if (!app?.ActiveDocument) {
+    return "";
+  }
+
+  const range = getSelectionRange(app);
+  return range?.Text ? String(range.Text) : "";
+}
+
+export function hasWpsDocument() {
+  const app = getApplication();
+  return Boolean(app?.ActiveDocument);
+}
+
+export function createStreamingWriter({ replaceSelection }) {
+  const app = getApplication();
+  if (!app?.ActiveDocument) {
+    return {
+      locationLabel: "未检测到 WPS 文档，仅在侧边栏预览",
+      async update() {},
+      async finish() {},
+      async cancel() {}
+    };
+  }
+
+  const doc = app.ActiveDocument;
+  const selectionRange = getSelectionRange(app);
+
+  if (!selectionRange) {
+    throw new Error("无法获取当前文档选区。");
+  }
+
+  const start = Number(selectionRange.Start);
+  const end = Number(selectionRange.End);
+  const originalText = String(selectionRange.Text || "");
+  const anchor = start;
+  let latestText = "";
+  let pendingText = "";
+  let flushTimer = null;
+  let flushing = false;
+
+  if (replaceSelection && end > start) {
+    selectionRange.Text = "";
+  }
+
+  async function flushNow() {
+    if (flushing || latestText === pendingText) {
+      return;
+    }
+
+    flushing = true;
+    try {
+      latestText = pendingText;
+      const target = doc.Range(anchor, anchor + latestText.length);
+      target.Text = latestText;
+      forceRefresh(target);
+    } finally {
+      flushing = false;
+    }
+  }
+
+  return {
+    locationLabel: replaceSelection
+      ? "实时覆盖当前选区"
+      : "实时插入到当前光标位置",
+    async update(text) {
+      pendingText = text;
+      if (flushTimer !== null) {
+        return;
+      }
+
+      flushTimer = window.setTimeout(async () => {
+        flushTimer = null;
+        await flushNow();
+      }, 70);
+    },
+    async finish() {
+      if (flushTimer !== null) {
+        window.clearTimeout(flushTimer);
+        flushTimer = null;
+      }
+
+      await flushNow();
+      const endRange = doc.Range(anchor + latestText.length, anchor + latestText.length);
+      forceRefresh(endRange);
+    },
+    async cancel() {
+      if (flushTimer !== null) {
+        window.clearTimeout(flushTimer);
+        flushTimer = null;
+      }
+
+      if (!latestText && replaceSelection && originalText) {
+        doc.Range(anchor, anchor).Text = originalText;
+      }
+    }
+  };
+}
```

```diff
+import {
+  startTransition,
+  useDeferredValue,
+  useEffect,
+  useRef,
+  useState
+} from "react";
+import {
+  DEFAULT_SETTINGS,
+  PROVIDERS,
+  buildMessages,
+  streamCompletion
+} from "./ai";
+import {
+  PROMPT_KEY,
+  SETTINGS_KEY,
+  loadStoredValue,
+  saveStoredValue
+} from "./storage";
+import {
+  createStreamingWriter,
+  detectHostLabel,
+  hasWpsDocument,
+  readSelectionText
+} from "./wps";
+
+function providerLabel(providerId) {
+  return PROVIDERS[providerId]?.label ?? providerId;
+}
+
+function placeholderModel(providerId) {
+  return PROVIDERS[providerId]?.placeholderModel ?? "";
+}
+
+export default function App() {
+  const [settings, setSettings] = useState(() =>
+    loadStoredValue(SETTINGS_KEY, DEFAULT_SETTINGS)
+  );
+  const [prompt, setPrompt] = useState(() =>
+    loadStoredValue(
+      PROMPT_KEY,
+      "请基于当前选区内容进行正式化改写，并补充必要的结构与表达。"
+    )
+  );
+  const [selectionText, setSelectionText] = useState("");
+  const [hostLabel, setHostLabel] = useState("检测中");
+  const [status, setStatus] = useState("等待连接");
+  const [error, setError] = useState("");
+  const [output, setOutput] = useState("");
+  const [isGenerating, setIsGenerating] = useState(false);
+
+  const deferredOutput = useDeferredValue(output);
+  const abortRef = useRef(null);
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    saveStoredValue(SETTINGS_KEY, settings);
+  }, [settings]);
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    saveStoredValue(PROMPT_KEY, prompt);
+  }, [prompt]);
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    setHostLabel(detectHostLabel());
+
+    if (hasWpsDocument()) {
+      setStatus("已连接 WPS，可实时写入正文");
+      setSelectionText(readSelectionText());
+    } else {
+      setStatus("当前未连接 WPS 文档，仅支持侧边栏预览");
+    }
+  }, []);
+
+  function updateSetting(key, value) {
+    setSettings((current) => ({ ...current, [key]: value }));
+  }
+
+  function switchProvider(providerId) {
+    setSettings((current) => ({
+      ...current,
+      providerId,
+      baseUrl: PROVIDERS[providerId].defaultBaseUrl
+    }));
+  }
+
+  function refreshSelection() {
+    try {
+      const text = readSelectionText();
+      setSelectionText(text);
+      setStatus(text ? "已读取当前选区" : "当前选区为空，将按光标位置写入");
+    } catch (caught) {
+      const message = caught instanceof Error ? caught.message : "读取选区失败";
+      setError(message);
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function stopGeneration() {
+    abortRef.current?.abort();
+    abortRef.current = null;
+    setIsGenerating(false);
+    setStatus("已停止生成");
+  }
+
+  async function handleGenerate() {
+    if (!settings.apiKey.trim()) {
+      setError("请先填写 API Key。");
+      return;
+    }
+
+    if (!settings.model.trim()) {
+      setError("请先填写模型 ID。");
+      return;
+    }
+
+    if (!prompt.trim()) {
+      setError("请先输入任务要求。");
+      return;
+    }
+
+    setError("");
+    setOutput("");
+    setIsGenerating(true);
+
+    let latestSelectionText = selectionText;
+    if (settings.useSelectionAsContext) {
+      latestSelectionText = readSelectionText();
+      setSelectionText(latestSelectionText);
+    }
+
+    const writer = createStreamingWriter({
+      replaceSelection: settings.replaceSelection
+    });
+
+    const controller = new AbortController();
+    abortRef.current = controller;
+    setStatus(writer.locationLabel);
+
+    try {
+      let aggregate = "";
+      for await (const chunk of streamCompletion({
+        settings,
+        messages: buildMessages({
+          prompt,
+          selectionText: latestSelectionText,
+          settings
+        }),
+        signal: controller.signal
+      })) {
+        aggregate += chunk;
+        await writer.update(aggregate);
+        startTransition(() => {
+          setOutput(aggregate);
+        });
+      }
+
+      await writer.finish();
+      setStatus(hasWpsDocument() ? "内容已写入 WPS 正文" : "仅在侧边栏完成预览");
+    } catch (caught) {
+      const aborted =
+        caught instanceof DOMException && caught.name === "AbortError";
+
+      if (aborted) {
+        await writer.cancel();
+        setStatus("已停止生成");
+      } else {
+        const message = caught instanceof Error ? caught.message : "生成失败";
+        setError(message);
+        setStatus("生成失败");
+      }
+    } finally {
+      abortRef.current = null;
+      setIsGenerating(false);
+    }
+  }
+
+  return (
+    <main className="shell">
+      <section className="hero panel">
+        <div className="hero-copy">
+          <span className="eyebrow">WPS AI Writer</span>
+          <h1>让 AI 边生成，边写进 WPS 正文</h1>
+          <p>
+            这不是聊天面板的复制品。它把模型输出直接锚定到当前选区或光标位置，适合改写、续写和成稿。
+          </p>
+        </div>
+        <div className="hero-meta">
+          <span className="pill accent">{hostLabel}</span>
+          <span className="pill">{providerLabel(settings.providerId)}</span>
+          <span className="pill">{isGenerating ? "Streaming" : "Idle"}</span>
+        </div>
+      </section>
+
+      <section className="layout">
+        <div className="column">
+          <section className="panel stack">
+            <div className="section-head">
+              <div>
+                <span className="section-kicker">Task</span>
+                <h2>任务输入</h2>
+              </div>
+              <button className="ghost-button" onClick={refreshSelection}>
+                读取选区
+              </button>
+            </div>
+
+            <label className="field">
+              <span>任务要求</span>
+              <textarea
+                rows="8"
+                value={prompt}
+                onChange={(event) => setPrompt(event.target.value)}
+                placeholder="例如：把当前选中的会议纪要改写成正式项目周报，保留事实，提升结构和措辞。"
+              />
+            </label>
+
+            <label className="field">
+              <span>系统提示词</span>
+              <textarea
+                rows="5"
+                value={settings.systemPrompt}
+                onChange={(event) => updateSetting("systemPrompt", event.target.value)}
+              />
+            </label>
+
+            <div className="toggle-grid">
+              <label className="toggle">
+                <input
+                  type="checkbox"
+                  checked={settings.useSelectionAsContext}
+                  onChange={(event) =>
+                    updateSetting("useSelectionAsContext", event.target.checked)
+                  }
+                />
+                <span>把当前选区作为上下文</span>
+              </label>
+
+              <label className="toggle">
+                <input
+                  type="checkbox"
+                  checked={settings.replaceSelection}
+                  onChange={(event) =>
+                    updateSetting("replaceSelection", event.target.checked)
+                  }
+                />
+                <span>直接覆盖当前选区</span>
+              </label>
+            </div>
+
+            <div className="action-row">
+              <button
+                className="primary-button"
+                onClick={() => void handleGenerate()}
+                disabled={isGenerating}
+              >
+                生成并写入正文
+              </button>
+              <button
+                className="secondary-button"
+                onClick={() => void stopGeneration()}
+                disabled={!isGenerating}
+              >
+                停止
+              </button>
+            </div>
+          </section>
+
+          <section className="panel stack">
+            <div className="section-head">
+              <div>
+                <span className="section-kicker">Selection</span>
+                <h2>文档上下文</h2>
+              </div>
+              <span className="status-text">{status}</span>
+            </div>
+
+            <pre className="content-box selection-box">
+              {selectionText || "当前没有读取到选区内容。"}
+            </pre>
+          </section>
+        </div>
+
+        <div className="column">
+          <section className="panel stack">
+            <div className="section-head">
+              <div>
+                <span className="section-kicker">Provider</span>
+                <h2>模型配置</h2>
+              </div>
+            </div>
+
+            <label className="field">
+              <span>Provider</span>
+              <select
+                value={settings.providerId}
+                onChange={(event) => switchProvider(event.target.value)}
+              >
+                {Object.values(PROVIDERS).map((provider) => (
+                  <option key={provider.id} value={provider.id}>

+
+            <label className="field">
+              <span>API Key</span>

+                type="password"
+                value={settings.apiKey}
+                onChange={(event) => updateSetting("apiKey", event.target.value)}
+                placeholder="sk-..."
+              />
+            </label>
+
+            <label className="field">
+              <span>Base URL</span>
+              <input
+                value={settings.baseUrl}
+                onChange={(event) => updateSetting("baseUrl", event.target.value)}
+              />
+            </label>
+
+            <label className="field">
+              <span>Model</span>
+              <input
+                value={settings.model}
+                onChange={(event) => updateSetting("model", event.target.value)}
+                placeholder={placeholderModel(settings.providerId)}
+              />
+            </label>
+
+            <div className="numeric-grid">
+              <label className="field">
+                <span>Temperature</span>
+                <input
+                  type="number"
+                  min="0"
+                  max="2"
+                  step="0.1"
+                  value={settings.temperature}
+                  onChange={(event) =>
+                    updateSetting("temperature", Number(event.target.value || 0))
+                  }
+                />
+              </label>
+              <label className="field">
+                <span>Max Tokens</span>
+                <input
+                  type="number"
+                  min="1"
+                  step="1"
+                  value={settings.maxTokens}
+                  onChange={(event) =>
+                    updateSetting("maxTokens", Number(event.target.value || 1))
+                  }
+                />
+              </label>
+            </div>
+
+            {settings.providerId === "openrouter" ? (
+              <div className="numeric-grid">
+                <label className="field">
+                  <span>HTTP-Referer</span>
+                  <input
+                    value={settings.referer}
+                    onChange={(event) => updateSetting("referer", event.target.value)}
+                  />
+                </label>
+                <label className="field">
+                  <span>X-Title</span>
+                  <input
+                    value={settings.title}
+                    onChange={(event) => updateSetting("title", event.target.value)}
+                  />
+                </label>
+              </div>
+            ) : null}
+          </section>
+
+          <section className="panel stack">
+            <div className="section-head">
+              <div>
+                <span className="section-kicker">Live Output</span>
+                <h2>流式结果</h2>
+              </div>
+            </div>
+
+            <pre className="content-box output-box">
+              {deferredOutput || "生成开始后，这里会和 WPS 正文同步刷新。"}
+            </pre>
+
+            {error ? <div className="error-box">{error}</div> : null}
+          </section>
+        </div>
+      </section>
+    </main>
+  );
+}
```

**Add: `D:\cursor_dev\wps_ai\README.md`**

```diff
+# WPS AI
+
+这是一个从零重建的 WPS 文字加载项项目，目标是：
+
+- 在 WPS 中作为任务窗格插件使用
+- 支持配置 `OpenRouter` 或 `NVIDIA Build` 的 OpenAI 兼容接口
+- 将模型流式输出实时写入 WPS 正文
+
+## 开发
+
+```bash
+npm install
+npm run dev
+```
+
+## 在 WPS 中调试
+
+```bash
+npm run debug
+```
+
+前提是本机已安装支持 `wpsjs debug` 的 WPS 客户端。
+
+## 构建
+
+```bash
+npm run build
+```
+
+构建后 `dist/` 中会包含：
+
+- `manifest.xml`
+- `ribbon.xml`
+- 任务窗格页面和资源
+
+## 项目结构
+
+- `src/ribbon`
+  功能区入口和任务窗格创建逻辑
+- `src/taskpane/App.jsx`
+  主界面、配置和流式生成流程
+- `src/taskpane/ai.js`
+  OpenRouter / NVIDIA Build 接口封装和 SSE 解析
+- `src/taskpane/wps.js`
+  WPS 文档读写桥接
+
+## 写入策略
+
+生成开始时，插件会记录当前选区的 `Start/End`。
+
+- 勾选“直接覆盖当前选区”时：
+  会先清空原选区，再把流式文本持续覆写到同一锚点区域。
+- 取消勾选时：
+  会在当前光标位置持续插入并刷新同一段落区域。
+
+这样可以避免逐 token 插入导致光标漂移和正文碎片化。
```

+function ensureTaskPane() {
+  const storage = window.Application.PluginStorage;
+  const existingId = storage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
+
+  if (existingId) {

+    if (existing) {
+      return existing;
+    }
+  }
+
+  const taskPane = window.Application.CreateTaskPane(getTaskPaneUrl());

+  return taskPane;
+}

+const ribbon = {

+      window.Application.ribbonUI = ribbonUI;
+    }
+
+    return true;
+  },
+
+  OnAction(control) {
+    const doc = window.Application?.ActiveDocument;
+    if (!doc) {
+      alert("当前没有打开任何文字文档。");
+      return true;
+    }
+
+    const taskPane = ensureTaskPane();
+
+    switch (control.Id) {
+      case "btnToggleTaskPane":
+        taskPane.Visible = !taskPane.Visible;
+        break;
+      case "btnFocusTaskPane":
+        taskPane.Visible = true;
+        break;
+      default:
+        break;
+    }
+
+    return true;
+  },
+
+  GetImage(control) {
+    if (control.Id === "btnFocusTaskPane") {
+      return "images/ai-stream.svg";
+    }
+
+    return "images/ai-pane.svg";
+  },
+
+  OnGetEnabled() {
+    return Boolean(window.Application?.ActiveDocument);
+  }
+};

+export default ribbon;

+export function loadStoredValue(key, fallbackValue) {
+  try {
+    const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(key);
+    return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : fallbackValue;
+  } catch {
+    return fallbackValue;
+  }
+}

+export function saveStoredValue(key, value) {
+  try {
+    window.localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(value));
+  } catch {
+    // Ignore local storage failures in host environments with tighter quotas.
+  }
+}

+export const PROVIDERS = {
+  openrouter: {
+    id: "openrouter",
+    label: "OpenRouter",
+    defaultBaseUrl: "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1",
+    placeholderModel: "openai/gpt-4.1-mini"
+  },
+  nvidia: {
+    id: "nvidia",
+    label: "NVIDIA Build",
+    defaultBaseUrl: "https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1",
+    placeholderModel: "meta/llama-3.1-70b-instruct"
+  }
+};
+
+export const DEFAULT_SETTINGS = {
+  providerId: "openrouter",
+  baseUrl: PROVIDERS.openrouter.defaultBaseUrl,
+  apiKey: "",
+  model: "",
+  temperature: 0.5,
+  maxTokens: 4096,
+  systemPrompt:
+    "你是 WPS 文档助手。请输出适合直接写入正式文档正文的中文内容，结构清晰，避免寒暄和元叙述。",
+  referer: "https://localhost",
+  title: "WPS AI Plugin",
+  useSelectionAsContext: true,
+  replaceSelection: true
+};
+
+function normalizeContent(content) {
+  if (typeof content === "string") {
+    return content;
+  }
+
+  if (!Array.isArray(content)) {
+    return "";
+  }
+
+  return content
+    .map((item) => {
+      if (typeof item === "string") {
+        return item;
+      }
+
+      if (item && typeof item === "object" && "text" in item) {
+        return String(item.text ?? "");
+      }
+
+      return "";
+    })
+    .join("");
+}
+
+function extractChunk(payload) {
+  const choice = payload?.choices?.[0];
+  if (!choice) {
+    return "";
+  }
+
+  return (
+    normalizeContent(choice.delta?.content) ||
+    normalizeContent(choice.message?.content) ||
+    ""
+  );
+}
+
+async function buildError(response) {
+  const contentType = response.headers.get("content-type") ?? "";
+
+  try {
+    if (contentType.includes("application/json")) {
+      const json = await response.json();
+      return json?.error?.message || JSON.stringify(json);
+    }
+
+    return await response.text();
+  } catch {
+    return `${response.status} ${response.statusText}`;
+  }
+}
+
+export function buildMessages({ prompt, selectionText, settings }) {
+  const selectionBlock =
+    settings.useSelectionAsContext && selectionText.trim()
+      ? [
+          "以下内容是用户当前在 WPS 文档中选中的正文，请将其作为上下文，不要机械重复：",
+          "",
+          "---- 选区开始 ----",
+          selectionText.trim(),
+          "---- 选区结束 ----",
+          ""
+        ].join("\n")
+      : "";
+
+  return [
+    {
+      role: "system",
+      content: settings.systemPrompt.trim()
+    },
+    {
+      role: "user",
+      content: `${selectionBlock}${prompt.trim()}`
+    }
+  ];
+}
+
+export async function* streamCompletion({ settings, messages, signal }) {
+  const headers = {
+    "Content-Type": "application/json",
+    Authorization: `Bearer ${settings.apiKey.trim()}`
+  };
+
+  if (settings.providerId === "openrouter") {
+    headers["HTTP-Referer"] = settings.referer.trim() || "https://localhost";
+    headers["X-Title"] = settings.title.trim() || "WPS AI Plugin";
+  }
+
+  const response = await fetch(
+    `${settings.baseUrl.replace(/\/+$/, "")}/chat/completions`,
+    {
+      method: "POST",
+      headers,
+      body: JSON.stringify({
+        model: settings.model.trim(),
+        messages,
+        temperature: Number(settings.temperature),
+        max_tokens: Number(settings.maxTokens),
+        stream: true
+      }),
+      signal
+    }
+  );
+
+  if (!response.ok) {
+    throw new Error(await buildError(response));
+  }
+
+  if (!response.body) {
+    const json = await response.json();
+    const fallbackText = extractChunk(json);
+    if (fallbackText) {
+      yield fallbackText;
+    }
+    return;
+  }
+
+  const contentType = response.headers.get("content-type") ?? "";
+  if (!contentType.includes("text/event-stream")) {
+    const json = await response.json();
+    const fallbackText = extractChunk(json);
+    if (fallbackText) {
+      yield fallbackText;
+    }
+    return;
+  }
+
+  const reader = response.body.getReader();
+  const decoder = new TextDecoder();
+  let buffer = "";
+
+  while (true) {
+    const { value, done } = await reader.read();
+
+    if (done) {
+      buffer += decoder.decode();
+      break;
+    }
+
+    buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
+    const parts = buffer.split(/\r?\n\r?\n/);
+    buffer = parts.pop() ?? "";
+
+    for (const part of parts) {
+      const lines = part
+        .split(/\r?\n/)
+        .filter((line) => line.startsWith("data:"))
+        .map((line) => line.slice(5).trim());
+
+      for (const line of lines) {
+        if (!line || line === "[DONE]") {
+          continue;
+        }
+
+        const payload = JSON.parse(line);
+        const text = extractChunk(payload);
+        if (text) {
+          yield text;
+        }
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  if (!buffer.trim()) {
+    return;
+  }
+
+  const lines = buffer
+    .split(/\r?\n/)
+    .filter((line) => line.startsWith("data:"))
+    .map((line) => line.slice(5).trim());
+
+  for (const line of lines) {
+    if (!line || line === "[DONE]") {
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const payload = JSON.parse(line);
+    const text = extractChunk(payload);
+    if (text) {
+      yield text;
+    }
+  }
+}

+function getApplication() {
+  if (window.Application) {
+    return window.Application;
+  }
+
+  if (window.wps?.Application) {
+    return window.wps.Application;
+  }
+
+  if (window.instance?.Application) {
+    return window.instance.Application;
+  }
+
+  return null;
+}
+
+function getSelectionRange(app) {
+  return app.Selection?.Range || app.ActiveDocument?.ActiveWindow?.Selection?.Range || null;
+}
+
+function forceRefresh(range) {
+  try {
+    if (range && typeof range.Select === "function") {
+      range.Select();
+    }
+  } catch {
+    // Ignore redraw issues on hosts that do not support Select.
+  }
+}
+
+export function detectHostLabel() {
+  if (window.Application) {
+    return "WPS 本地插件";
+  }
+
+  if (window.wps?.Application) {
+    return "WPS 宿主";
+  }
+
+  if (window.instance?.Application) {
+    return "WebOffice 宿主";
+  }
+
+  return "浏览器预览";
+}
+
+export function readSelectionText() {
+  const app = getApplication();
+  if (!app?.ActiveDocument) {
+    return "";
+  }
+
+  const range = getSelectionRange(app);
+  return range?.Text ? String(range.Text) : "";
+}
+
+export function hasWpsDocument() {
+  const app = getApplication();
+  return Boolean(app?.ActiveDocument);
+}
+
+export function createStreamingWriter({ replaceSelection }) {
+  const app = getApplication();
+  if (!app?.ActiveDocument) {
+    return {
+      locationLabel: "未检测到 WPS 文档，仅在侧边栏预览",
+      async update() {},
+      async finish() {},
+      async cancel() {}
+    };
+  }
+
+  const doc = app.ActiveDocument;
+  const selectionRange = getSelectionRange(app);
+
+  if (!selectionRange) {
+    throw new Error("无法获取当前文档选区。");
+  }
+
+  const start = Number(selectionRange.Start);
+  const end = Number(selectionRange.End);
+  const originalText = String(selectionRange.Text || "");
+  const anchor = start;
+  let latestText = "";
+  let pendingText = "";
+  let flushTimer = null;
+  let flushing = false;
+
+  if (replaceSelection && end > start) {
+    selectionRange.Text = "";
+  }
+
+  async function flushNow() {
+    if (flushing || latestText === pendingText) {
+      return;
+    }
+
+    flushing = true;
+    try {
+      latestText = pendingText;
+      const target = doc.Range(anchor, anchor + latestText.length);
+      target.Text = latestText;
+      forceRefresh(target);
+    } finally {
+      flushing = false;
+    }
+  }
+
+  return {
+    locationLabel: replaceSelection
+      ? "实时覆盖当前选区"
+      : "实时插入到当前光标位置",
+    async update(text) {
+      pendingText = text;
+      if (flushTimer !== null) {
+        return;
+      }
+
+      flushTimer = window.setTimeout(async () => {
+        flushTimer = null;
+        await flushNow();
+      }, 70);
+    },
+    async finish() {
+      if (flushTimer !== null) {
+        window.clearTimeout(flushTimer);
+        flushTimer = null;
+      }
+
+      await flushNow();
+      const endRange = doc.Range(anchor + latestText.length, anchor + latestText.length);
+      forceRefresh(endRange);
+    },
+    async cancel() {
+      if (flushTimer !== null) {
+        window.clearTimeout(flushTimer);
+        flushTimer = null;
+      }
+
+      if (!latestText && replaceSelection && originalText) {
+        doc.Range(anchor, anchor).Text = originalText;
+      }
+    }
+  };
+}

+  const [isGenerating, setIsGenerating] = useState(false);
+

+  function refreshSelection() {

+            </div>
+
+            {settings.providerId === "openrouter" ? (
+              <div className="numeric-grid">
+                <label className="field">
+                  <span>HTTP-Referer</span>
+                  <input
+                    value={settings.referer}
+                    onChange={(event) => updateSetting("referer", event.target.value)}
+                  />
+                </label>
+                <label className="field">
+                  <span>X-Title</span>
+                  <input
+                    value={settings.title}
+                    onChange={(event) => updateSetting("title", event.target.value)}
+                  />
+                </label>
+              </div>
+            ) : null}
+          </section>
+
+          <section className="panel stack">
+            <div className="section-head">
+              <div>
+                <span className="section-kicker">Live Output</span>
+                <h2>流式结果</h2>
+              </div>
+            </div>
+
+            <pre className="content-box output-box">
+              {deferredOutput || "生成开始后，这里会和 WPS 正文同步刷新。"}
+            </pre>
+
+            {error ? <div className="error-box">{error}</div> : null}
+          </section>
+        </div>
+      </section>
+    </main>
+  );
+}
```

**Add: `D:\cursor_dev\wps_ai\README.md`**

```diff
+# WPS AI
+
+这是一个从零重建的 WPS 文字加载项项目，目标是：
+
+- 在 WPS 中作为任务窗格插件使用
+- 支持配置 `OpenRouter` 或 `NVIDIA Build` 的 OpenAI 兼容接口
+- 将模型流式输出实时写入 WPS 正文
+
+## 开发
+
+```bash
+npm install
+npm run dev
+```
+
+## 在 WPS 中调试
+
+```bash
+npm run debug
+```
+
+前提是本机已安装支持 `wpsjs debug` 的 WPS 客户端。
+
+## 构建
+
+```bash
+npm run build
+```
+
+构建后 `dist/` 中会包含：
+
+- `manifest.xml`
+- `ribbon.xml`
+- 任务窗格页面和资源
+
+## 项目结构
+
+- `src/ribbon`
+  功能区入口和任务窗格创建逻辑
+- `src/taskpane/App.jsx`
+  主界面、配置和流式生成流程
+- `src/taskpane/ai.js`
+  OpenRouter / NVIDIA Build 接口封装和 SSE 解析
+- `src/taskpane/wps.js`
+  WPS 文档读写桥接
+
+## 写入策略
+
+生成开始时，插件会记录当前选区的 `Start/End`。
+
+- 勾选“直接覆盖当前选区”时：
+  会先清空原选区，再把流式文本持续覆写到同一锚点区域。
+- 取消勾选时：
+  会在当前光标位置持续插入并刷新同一段落区域。
+
+这样可以避免逐 token 插入导致光标漂移和正文碎片化。
```

- 生成结果按聊天气泡展示，流式状态直接显示在消息里，同时继续实时写入 WPS 正文。

+export default function App() {

+

+

+

+  useEffect(() => {

+
+  function clearConversation() {

+      return;

+
+    setMessages([]);
+    setError("");

+
+  return (

+
+          <button

+            type="button"

+

      }

_**Agent (gpt-5.4 2026-04-15 12:57:01Z)**_

测试结果已经明确了：

你的 NVIDIA 配置本身是可用的。我用你给的 `base URL + model + key` 在本机直接请求 `https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1/chat/completions`，实际返回了 `"OK"`。所以不是模型名错，也不是 key 错。

问题出在当前插件的调用方式。现在前端是在 [ai.js](D:/cursor_dev/wps_ai/src/taskpane/ai.js#L108) 里直接用浏览器 `fetch()` 去打 NVIDIA。这个路径在 WPS 任务窗格里很容易因为跨域或 WebView/代理链路被拦掉，于是前端只会看到通用错误 `Failed to fetch`。我本机同时确认了：
- 当前用户侧代理是开着的
- WinHTTP 代理是直连
- 命令行请求 NVIDIA 仍然成功

这说明“系统能访问 NVIDIA”没问题，但“WPS 前端直连 NVIDIA”这条链路有问题。对比看，OpenRouter 响应里明确带了 `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`，而 NVIDIA 这边我检查到的是 `Vary: Origin`，前端直连更容易在 WebView 里被拦。

我已经顺手把报错改清楚了，后面再失败时不会只显示笼统的 `Failed to fetch`，代码在 [ai.js](D:/cursor_dev/wps_ai/src/taskpane/ai.js#L108)。

下一步最稳的修法不是继续改 key，而是加一个本地/服务端 relay：
- WPS 前端只请求你自己的 `/api/chat/completions`
- relay 再去请求 NVIDIA
- 这样可以绕开前端跨域和 WebView 代理问题

如果你要，我下一条直接给这个项目加上本地 relay，让 NVIDIA 能在 WPS 里实际跑通。

另外，你刚刚把真实 API key 发出来了，建议尽快到 NVIDIA 控制台轮换掉。

参考：
- NVIDIA LLM API / 模型列表：https://docs.api.nvidia.com/nim/reference/llm-apis
- OpenRouter Chat Completions：https://openrouter.ai/docs/api/api-reference/chat/send-chat-completion-request

function onbuttonclick(idStr)
{
    if (typeof (window.Application.Enum) != "object") { // 濡傛灉娌℃湁鍐呯疆鏋氫妇鍊?
        window.Application.Enum = WPS_Enum

                if (tsId){
                    let tskpane = window.Application.GetTaskPane(tsId)
                    tskpane.DockPosition = window.Application.Enum.msoCTPDockPositionLeft
                }
                break
            }
        case "dockRight":{
            let tsId = window.Application.PluginStorage.getItem("taskpane_id")
                if (tsId){
                    let tskpane = window.Application.GetTaskPane(tsId)
                    tskpane.DockPosition = window.Application.Enum.msoCTPDockPositionRight
                }

        }

            let tsId = window.Application.PluginStorage.getItem("taskpane_id")

async function debug(...options) {
	const xmlDebug = require('./debug_xmlplugin')
	const publishDebug = require('./debug_publish')
	needPublishDebug().then(b=>{
		return b ? publishDebug.debug(...options) : xmlDebug(...options)
	})
}

async function needPublishDebug(){
	var bPersonal = false;
	var versionCfgpath;
	if (os.platform() == 'win32') {
		return new Promise((r,j)=>{
			cp.exec("REG QUERY HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT\\KWPS.Document.12\\shell\\open\\command /ve", function (error, stdout, stderr) {
				var val = undefined;
				try {
					val = stdout.split("    ")[3].split('"')[1];
				} catch (err) {
					throw new Error("WPS鏈畨瑁咃紝璇峰畨瑁匴PS 2019 鏈€鏂扮増鏈€?)
				}
				if (typeof (val) == "undefined" || val == null) {
					throw new Error("WPS鏈畨瑁咃紝璇峰畨瑁匴PS 2019 鏈€鏂扮増鏈€?)
				}
				var pos = val.indexOf("wps.exe");
				if (pos < 0)
					pos = val.indexOf("wpsoffice.exe");
				if (pos < 0) {
					console.log(val)
					throw new Error("wps瀹夎寮傚父锛岃纭鏈夋病鏈夋纭殑瀹夎WPS 2019 鏈€鏂扮増鏈紒")
				}
				let versionCfgpath = val.substring(0, pos) + "cfgs/setup.cfg";
				r(versionCfgpath)
			});
		}).then(r=>{
			versionCfgpath = r
			if (!fsEx.existsSync(versionCfgpath))
				return false;
			var config = ini.parse(fs.readFileSync(versionCfgpath, 'utf-8'))
			var firstVer = config.Version.FirstVersion;
			var version = config.Version.Version;
			if (firstVer == '1' && version >= '16910')
				return true;
			if (firstVer == '9')
				return true;

			const projCfg = jsUtil.projectCfg()
			const scriptDev = projCfg.scripts.dev
			if (!scriptDev)
				return false
			const bVue3 = scriptDev.includes("vite")
			return bVue3;
		})
	} 

	return true;
}

module.exports = (...args) => {
	return debug(...args).catch(err => {
		console.error(err)
		if (!process.env.VUE_CLI_TEST) {
			process.exit(1)
		}
	})
}

+  res.setHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "authorization,content-type");
+}
+
+function sendJson(res, statusCode, payload) {
+  setCorsHeaders(res);
+  res.writeHead(statusCode, { "Content-Type": "application/json; charset=utf-8" });
+  res.end(JSON.stringify(payload));
+}
+
+async function readJsonBody(req) {
+  const chunks = [];
+  for await (const chunk of req) {
+    chunks.push(chunk);
+  }
+
+  const raw = Buffer.concat(chunks).toString("utf8");
+  if (!raw) {
+    return {};
+  }
+
+  return JSON.parse(raw);
+}
+
+async function handleNvidiaChat(req, res) {
+  const authorization = req.headers.authorization;
+  if (!authorization) {
+    sendJson(res, 400, {
+      error: {
+        message: "Missing Authorization header"
+      }
+    });
+    return;
+  }
+
+  let body;
+  try {
+    body = await readJsonBody(req);
+  } catch {
+    sendJson(res, 400, {
+      error: {
+        message: "Invalid JSON body"
+      }
+    });
+    return;
+  }
+
+  try {
+    const upstream = await fetch(NVIDIA_UPSTREAM, {
+      method: "POST",
+      headers: {
+        Authorization: authorization,
+        "Content-Type": "application/json"
+      },
+      body: JSON.stringify(body)
+    });
+
+    setCorsHeaders(res);
+
+    const contentType = upstream.headers.get("content-type");
+    if (contentType) {
+      res.setHeader("Content-Type", contentType);
+    }
+
+    const cacheControl = upstream.headers.get("cache-control");
+    if (cacheControl) {
+      res.setHeader("Cache-Control", cacheControl);
+    }
+
+    res.writeHead(upstream.status);
+
+    if (!upstream.body) {
+      res.end();
+      return;
+    }
+
+    Readable.fromWeb(upstream.body).pipe(res);
+  } catch (error) {
+    sendJson(res, 502, {
+      error: {
+        message:
+          error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Failed to reach NVIDIA upstream"
+      }
+    });
+  }
+}
+
+const server = createServer(async (req, res) => {
+  if (!req.url) {
+    sendJson(res, 404, { error: { message: "Not found" } });
+    return;
+  }
+
+  if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {
+    setCorsHeaders(res);
+    res.writeHead(204);
+    res.end();
+    return;
+  }
+
+  if (req.method === "GET" && req.url === "/health") {
+    sendJson(res, 200, { ok: true, provider: "nvidia-relay" });
+    return;
+  }
+
+  if (req.method === "POST" && req.url === "/nvidia/v1/chat/completions") {
+    await handleNvidiaChat(req, res);
+    return;
+  }
+
+  sendJson(res, 404, { error: { message: "Not found" } });
+});
+
+server.listen(PORT, "127.0.0.1", () => {
+  console.log(`WPS AI relay listening on http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}`);
+});
```

import { createServer } from "node:http";
import { Readable } from "node:stream";

const PORT = 3888;
const NVIDIA_UPSTREAM = "https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1/chat/completions";

function setCorsHeaders(res) {
  res.setHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*");
  res.setHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "GET,POST,OPTIONS");
  res.setHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "authorization,content-type");
}

function sendJson(res, statusCode, payload) {
  setCorsHeaders(res);
  res.writeHead(statusCode, { "Content-Type": "application/json; charset=utf-8" });
  res.end(JSON.stringify(payload));
}

async function readJsonBody(req) {
  const chunks = [];
  for await (const chunk of req) {
    chunks.push(chunk);
  }

  const raw = Buffer.concat(chunks).toString("utf8");
  if (!raw) {
    return {};
  }

  return JSON.parse(raw);
}

async function handleNvidiaChat(req, res) {
  const authorization = req.headers.authorization;
  if (!authorization) {
    sendJson(res, 400, {
      error: {
        message: "Missing Authorization header"
      }
    });
    return;
  }

  let body;
  try {
    body = await readJsonBody(req);
  } catch {
    sendJson(res, 400, {
      error: {
        message: "Invalid JSON body"
      }
    });
    return;
  }

  try {
    const upstream = await fetch(NVIDIA_UPSTREAM, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: {
        Authorization: authorization,
        "Content-Type": "application/json"
      },
      body: JSON.stringify(body)
    });

    setCorsHeaders(res);

    const contentType = upstream.headers.get("content-type");
    if (contentType) {
      res.setHeader("Content-Type", contentType);
    }

    const cacheControl = upstream.headers.get("cache-control");
    if (cacheControl) {
      res.setHeader("Cache-Control", cacheControl);
    }

    res.writeHead(upstream.status);

    if (!upstream.body) {
      res.end();
      return;
    }

    Readable.fromWeb(upstream.body).pipe(res);
  } catch (error) {
    sendJson(res, 502, {
      error: {
        message:
          error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Failed to reach NVIDIA upstream"
      }
    });
  }
}

const server = createServer(async (req, res) => {
  if (!req.url) {
    sendJson(res, 404, { error: { message: "Not found" } });
    return;
  }

  if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {
    setCorsHeaders(res);
    res.writeHead(204);
    res.end();
    return;
  }

  if (req.method === "GET" && req.url === "/health") {
    sendJson(res, 200, { ok: true, provider: "nvidia-relay" });
    return;
  }

  if (req.method === "POST" && req.url === "/nvidia/v1/chat/completions") {
    await handleNvidiaChat(req, res);
    return;
  }

  sendJson(res, 404, { error: { message: "Not found" } });
});

server.listen(PORT, "127.0.0.1", () => {
  console.log(`WPS AI relay listening on http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}`);
});
```
</details></tool-use>

function getApplication() {
  if (window.Application) {
    return window.Application;
  }

  if (window.wps?.Application) {
    return window.wps.Application;
  }

  if (window.instance?.Application) {
    return window.instance.Application;
  }

  return null;
}

function getSelectionRange(app) {
  return app.Selection?.Range || app.ActiveDocument?.ActiveWindow?.Selection?.Range || null;
}

function forceRefresh(range) {
  try {
    if (range && typeof range.Select === "function") {
      range.Select();
    }
  } catch {
    // Ignore redraw issues on hosts that do not support Select.
  }
}

export function detectHostLabel() {
  if (window.Application) {
    return "WPS 鏈湴鎻掍欢";
  }

  if (window.wps?.Application) {
    return "WPS 瀹夸富";
  }

  if (window.instance?.Application) {
    return "WebOffice 瀹夸富";
  }

  return "娴忚鍣ㄩ瑙?;
}

export function readSelectionText() {
  const app = getApplication();
  if (!app?.ActiveDocument) {
    return "";
  }

  const range = getSelectionRange(app);
  return range?.Text ? String(range.Text) : "";
}

export function hasWpsDocument() {
  const app = getApplication();
  return Boolean(app?.ActiveDocument);
}

export function createStreamingWriter({ replaceSelection }) {
  const app = getApplication();
  if (!app?.ActiveDocument) {
    return {
      locationLabel: "鏈娴嬪埌 WPS 鏂囨。锛屼粎鍦ㄤ晶杈规爮棰勮",
      async update() {},
      async finish() {},
      async cancel() {}
    };
  }

  const doc = app.ActiveDocument;
  const selectionRange = getSelectionRange(app);

  if (!selectionRange) {
    throw new Error("鏃犳硶鑾峰彇褰撳墠鏂囨。閫夊尯銆?);
  }

  const start = Number(selectionRange.Start);
  const end = Number(selectionRange.End);
  const originalText = String(selectionRange.Text || "");
  const anchor = replaceSelection ? start : end;
  let latestText = "";
  let pendingText = "";
  let flushTimer = null;
  let flushing = false;

  if (replaceSelection && end > start) {
    selectionRange.Text = "";
  }

  async function flushNow() {
    if (flushing || latestText === pendingText) {
      return;
    }

    flushing = true;
    try {
      latestText = pendingText;
      const target = doc.Range(anchor, anchor + latestText.length);
      target.Text = latestText;
      forceRefresh(target);
    } finally {
      flushing = false;
    }
  }

  return {
    locationLabel: replaceSelection
      ? "瀹炴椂瑕嗙洊褰撳墠閫夊尯"
      : "瀹炴椂鎻掑叆鍒板綋鍓嶅厜鏍囦綅缃?,
    async update(text) {
      pendingText = text;
      if (flushTimer !== null) {
        return;
      }

      flushTimer = window.setTimeout(async () => {
        flushTimer = null;
        await flushNow();
      }, 70);
    },
    async finish() {
      if (flushTimer !== null) {
        window.clearTimeout(flushTimer);
        flushTimer = null;
      }

      await flushNow();
      const endRange = doc.Range(anchor + latestText.length, anchor + latestText.length);
      forceRefresh(endRange);
    },
    async cancel() {
      if (flushTimer !== null) {
        window.clearTimeout(flushTimer);
        flushTimer = null;
      }

      if (!latestText && replaceSelection && originalText) {
        doc.Range(anchor, anchor).Text = originalText;
      }
    }
  };
}
