+import { spawn } from "node:child_process";
+import { createServer } from "node:http";
+
+const PORT = 3888;
+const NVIDIA_UPSTREAM = "https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1/chat/completions";
+const CURL_BIN = process.platform === "win32" ? "curl.exe" : "curl";
+const MAX_HEADER_BYTES = 64 * 1024;
+
+function setCorsHeaders(res) {
+  res.setHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*");
+  res.setHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "GET,POST,OPTIONS");
+  res.setHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "authorization,content-type");
+}
+
+function sendJson(res, statusCode, payload) {
+  setCorsHeaders(res);
+  res.writeHead(statusCode, { "Content-Type": "application/json; charset=utf-8" });
+  res.end(JSON.stringify(payload));
+}
+
+async function readJsonBody(req) {
+  const chunks = [];
+  for await (const chunk of req) {
+    chunks.push(chunk);
+  }
+
+  const raw = Buffer.concat(chunks).toString("utf8");
+  if (!raw) {
+    return {};
+  }
+
+  return JSON.parse(raw);
+}
+
+function findHeaderBoundary(buffer) {
+  const crlf = buffer.indexOf("\r\n\r\n");
+  if (crlf !== -1) {
+    return { index: crlf, length: 4 };
+  }
+
+  const lf = buffer.indexOf("\n\n");
+  if (lf !== -1) {
+    return { index: lf, length: 2 };
+  }
+
+  return null;
+}
+
+function parseHeaderBlock(block) {
+  const lines = block
+    .split(/\r?\n/)
+    .map((line) => line.trimEnd())
+    .filter(Boolean);
+
+  if (lines.length === 0) {
+    return null;
+  }
+
+  const statusMatch = lines[0].match(/^HTTP\/\d+(?:\.\d+)?\s+(\d{3})/i);
+  if (!statusMatch) {
+    return null;
+  }
+
+  const headers = {};
+  for (const line of lines.slice(1)) {
+    const separator = line.indexOf(":");
+    if (separator === -1) {
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const name = line.slice(0, separator).trim().toLowerCase();
+    const value = line.slice(separator + 1).trim();
+    headers[name] = value;
+  }
+
+  return {
+    statusCode: Number(statusMatch[1]),
+    statusLine: lines[0],
+    headers
+  };
+}
+
+function isInterimResponse(parsed) {
+  if (!parsed) {
+    return false;
+  }
+
+  if (/connection established/i.test(parsed.statusLine)) {
+    return true;
+  }
+
+  return parsed.statusCode >= 100 && parsed.statusCode < 200;
+}
+
+function formatCurlFailure(stderr) {
+  const message = stderr.trim();
+  if (!message) {
+    return "Failed to reach NVIDIA upstream";
+  }
+
+  return message.replace(/^curl:\s*/i, "");
+}
+
+function createCurlArgs(authorization) {
+  return [
+    "-sS",
+    "-N",
+    "-D",
+    "-",
+    "-X",
+    "POST",
+    "-H",
+    `Authorization: ${authorization}`,
+    "-H",
+    "Content-Type: application/json",
+    "--data-binary",
+    "@-",
+    NVIDIA_UPSTREAM
+  ];
+}
+
+async function handleNvidiaChat(req, res) {
+  const authorization = req.headers.authorization;
+  if (!authorization) {
+    sendJson(res, 400, {
+      error: {
+        message: "Missing Authorization header"
+      }
+    });
+    return;
+  }
+
+  let body;
+  try {
+    body = await readJsonBody(req);
+  } catch {
+    sendJson(res, 400, {
+      error: {
+        message: "Invalid JSON body"
+      }
+    });
+    return;
+  }
+
+  const curl = spawn(CURL_BIN, createCurlArgs(authorization), {
+    stdio: ["pipe", "pipe", "pipe"],
+    windowsHide: true
+  });
+
+  let stderr = "";
+  let responseReady = false;
+  let headerBuffer = Buffer.alloc(0);
+  let finished = false;
+
+  function fail(statusCode, message) {
+    if (finished) {
+      return;
+    }
+
+    finished = true;
+    if (!res.headersSent) {
+      sendJson(res, statusCode, { error: { message } });
+      return;
+    }
+
+    res.end();
+  }
+
+  function beginResponse(parsed) {
+    setCorsHeaders(res);
+
+    if (parsed.headers["content-type"]) {
+      res.setHeader("Content-Type", parsed.headers["content-type"]);
+    }
+
+    if (parsed.headers["cache-control"]) {
+      res.setHeader("Cache-Control", parsed.headers["cache-control"]);
+    } else if (body.stream) {
+      res.setHeader("Cache-Control", "no-cache");
+    }
+
+    if (parsed.headers["nvcf-reqid"]) {
+      res.setHeader("X-NVCF-ReqId", parsed.headers["nvcf-reqid"]);
+    }
+
+    res.writeHead(parsed.statusCode);
+    responseReady = true;
+  }
+
+  req.on("close", () => {
+    if (!finished && !res.writableEnded) {
+      curl.kill();
+    }
+  });
+
+  curl.on("error", (error) => {
+    fail(502, error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Failed to start curl");
+  });
+
+  curl.stderr.on("data", (chunk) => {
+    stderr += chunk.toString("utf8");
+  });
+
+  curl.stdout.on("data", (chunk) => {
+    if (finished) {
+      return;
+    }
+
+    if (responseReady) {
+      res.write(chunk);
+      return;
+    }
+
+    headerBuffer = Buffer.concat([headerBuffer, chunk]);
+
+    while (!responseReady) {
+      if (headerBuffer.length > MAX_HEADER_BYTES) {
+        curl.kill();
+        fail(502, "Invalid upstream response headers");
+        return;
+      }
+
+      const boundary = findHeaderBoundary(headerBuffer);
+      if (!boundary) {
+        return;
+      }
+
+      const block = headerBuffer.subarray(0, boundary.index).toString("utf8");
+      const rest = headerBuffer.subarray(boundary.index + boundary.length);
+      headerBuffer = rest;
+
+      const parsed = parseHeaderBlock(block);
+      if (!parsed) {
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      if (isInterimResponse(parsed)) {
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      beginResponse(parsed);
+      if (headerBuffer.length > 0) {
+        res.write(headerBuffer);
+        headerBuffer = Buffer.alloc(0);
+      }
+      return;
+    }
+  });
+
+  curl.stdout.on("end", () => {
+    if (finished) {
+      return;
+    }
+
+    finished = true;
+    if (!res.writableEnded) {
+      res.end();
+    }
+  });
+
+  curl.on("close", (code) => {
+    if (finished) {
+      return;
+    }
+
+    if (!responseReady) {
+      fail(502, formatCurlFailure(stderr || `curl exited with code ${code ?? "unknown"}`));
+      return;
+    }
+
+    finished = true;
+    if (!res.writableEnded) {
+      res.end();
+    }
+  });
+
+  curl.stdin.end(JSON.stringify(body));
+}
+
+const server = createServer(async (req, res) => {

+    sendJson(res, 404, { error: { message: "Not found" } });
+    return;
+  }
+
+  if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {

+    return;
+  }

+  if (req.method === "GET" && req.url === "/health") {

+      transport: "curl"

+  }

**Add: `d:\cursor_dev\wps_ai\server\relay.mjs`**

```diff
+import { spawn } from "node:child_process";
+import { createServer } from "node:http";
+
+const PORT = 3888;
+const NVIDIA_UPSTREAM = "https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1/chat/completions";
+const CURL_BIN = process.platform === "win32" ? "curl.exe" : "curl";
+
+function setCorsHeaders(res) {
+  res.setHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*");
+  res.setHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "GET,POST,OPTIONS");
+  res.setHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "authorization,content-type");
+}
+
+function sendJson(res, statusCode, payload) {
+  setCorsHeaders(res);
+  res.writeHead(statusCode, { "Content-Type": "application/json; charset=utf-8" });
+  res.end(JSON.stringify(payload));
+}
+
+async function readJsonBody(req) {
+  const chunks = [];
+  for await (const chunk of req) {
+    chunks.push(chunk);
+  }
+
+  const raw = Buffer.concat(chunks).toString("utf8");
+  if (!raw) {
+    return {};
+  }
+
+  return JSON.parse(raw);
+}
+
+function formatCurlFailure(stderr) {
+  const message = stderr.trim();
+  if (!message) {
+    return "Failed to reach NVIDIA upstream";
+  }
+
+  return message.replace(/^curl:\s*/i, "");
+}
+
+function createCurlArgs(authorization) {
+  return [
+    "-sS",
+    "-N",
+    "-f",
+    "-X",
+    "POST",
+    "-H",
+    `Authorization: ${authorization}`,
+    "-H",
+    "Content-Type: application/json",
+    "--data-binary",
+    "@-",
+    NVIDIA_UPSTREAM
+  ];
+}
+
+async function handleNvidiaChat(req, res) {
+  const authorization = req.headers.authorization;
+  if (!authorization) {
+    sendJson(res, 400, {
+      error: {
+        message: "Missing Authorization header"
+      }
+    });
+    return;
+  }
+
+  let body;
+  try {
+    body = await readJsonBody(req);
+  } catch {
+    sendJson(res, 400, {
+      error: {
+        message: "Invalid JSON body"
+      }
+    });
+    return;
+  }
+
+  const curl = spawn(CURL_BIN, createCurlArgs(authorization), {
+    stdio: ["pipe", "pipe", "pipe"],
+    windowsHide: true
+  });
+
+  let stderr = "";
+  let streamStarted = false;
+  let finished = false;
+
+  function fail(message) {
+    if (finished) {
+      return;
+    }
+
+    finished = true;
+    if (!res.headersSent) {
+      sendJson(res, 502, { error: { message } });
+      return;
+    }
+
+    res.end();
+  }
+
+  curl.on("error", (error) => {
+    fail(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Failed to start curl");
+  });
+
+  curl.stderr.on("data", (chunk) => {
+    stderr += chunk.toString("utf8");
+  });
+
+  curl.stdout.on("data", (chunk) => {
+    if (finished) {
+      return;
+    }
+
+    if (!streamStarted) {
+      setCorsHeaders(res);
+      res.writeHead(200, {
+        "Content-Type": "text/event-stream; charset=utf-8",
+        "Cache-Control": "no-cache"
+      });
+      streamStarted = true;
+    }
+
+    res.write(chunk);
+  });
+
+  curl.stdout.on("end", () => {
+    if (finished) {
+      return;
+    }
+
+    finished = true;
+    res.end();
+  });
+
+  curl.on("close", (code) => {
+    if (finished) {
+      return;
+    }
+
+    if (!streamStarted) {
+      fail(formatCurlFailure(stderr || `curl exited with code ${code ?? "unknown"}`));
+      return;
+    }
+
+    finished = true;
+    res.end();
+  });
+
+  req.on("aborted", () => {
+    if (!finished) {
+      curl.kill();
+    }
+  });
+
+  curl.stdin.end(JSON.stringify(body));
+}
+
+const server = createServer(async (req, res) => {
+  if (!req.url) {
+    sendJson(res, 404, { error: { message: "Not found" } });
+    return;
+  }
+
+  if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {
+    setCorsHeaders(res);
+    res.writeHead(204);
+    res.end();
+    return;
+  }
+
+  if (req.method === "GET" && req.url === "/health") {
+    sendJson(res, 200, {
+      ok: true,
+      provider: "nvidia-relay",
+      transport: "curl"
+    });
+    return;
+  }
+
+  if (req.method === "POST" && req.url === "/nvidia/v1/chat/completions") {
+    await handleNvidiaChat(req, res);
+    return;
+  }
+
+  sendJson(res, 404, { error: { message: "Not found" } });
+});
+
+server.listen(PORT, "127.0.0.1", () => {
+  console.log(`WPS AI relay listening on http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}`);
+});
```
</details></tool-use>

function getApplication() {
  if (window.Application) {
    return window.Application;
  }

  if (window.wps?.Application) {
    return window.wps.Application;
  }

  if (window.instance?.Application) {
    return window.instance.Application;
  }

  return null;
}

function getSelectionRange(app) {
  return app.Selection?.Range || app.ActiveDocument?.ActiveWindow?.Selection?.Range || null;
}

function forceRefresh(range) {
  try {
    if (range && typeof range.Select === "function") {
      range.Select();
    }
  } catch {
    // Ignore redraw issues on hosts that do not support Select.
  }
}

export function detectHostLabel() {
  if (window.Application) {
    return "WPS 鏈湴鎻掍欢";
  }

  if (window.wps?.Application) {
    return "WPS 瀹夸富";
  }

  if (window.instance?.Application) {
    return "WebOffice 瀹夸富";
  }

  return "娴忚鍣ㄩ瑙?;
}

export function readSelectionText() {
  const app = getApplication();
  if (!app?.ActiveDocument) {
    return "";
  }

  const range = getSelectionRange(app);
  return range?.Text ? String(range.Text) : "";
}

export function hasWpsDocument() {
  const app = getApplication();
  return Boolean(app?.ActiveDocument);
}

export function createStreamingWriter({ replaceSelection }) {
  const app = getApplication();
  if (!app?.ActiveDocument) {
    return {
      locationLabel: "鏈娴嬪埌 WPS 鏂囨。锛屼粎鍦ㄤ晶杈规爮棰勮",
      async update() {},
      async finish() {},
      async cancel() {}
    };
  }

  const doc = app.ActiveDocument;
  const selectionRange = getSelectionRange(app);

  if (!selectionRange) {
    throw new Error("鏃犳硶鑾峰彇褰撳墠鏂囨。閫夊尯銆?);
  }

  const start = Number(selectionRange.Start);
  const end = Number(selectionRange.End);
  const originalText = String(selectionRange.Text || "");
  const anchor = replaceSelection ? start : end;
  let latestText = "";
  let pendingText = "";
  let flushTimer = null;
  let flushing = false;

  if (replaceSelection && end > start) {
    selectionRange.Text = "";
  }

  async function flushNow() {
    if (flushing || latestText === pendingText) {
      return;
    }

    flushing = true;
    try {
      latestText = pendingText;
      const target = doc.Range(anchor, anchor + latestText.length);
      target.Text = latestText;
      forceRefresh(target);
    } finally {
      flushing = false;
    }
  }

  return {
    locationLabel: replaceSelection
      ? "瀹炴椂瑕嗙洊褰撳墠閫夊尯"
      : "瀹炴椂鎻掑叆鍒板綋鍓嶅厜鏍囦綅缃?,
    async update(text) {
      pendingText = text;
      if (flushTimer !== null) {
        return;
      }

      flushTimer = window.setTimeout(async () => {
        flushTimer = null;
        await flushNow();
      }, 70);
    },
    async finish() {
      if (flushTimer !== null) {
        window.clearTimeout(flushTimer);
        flushTimer = null;
      }

      await flushNow();
      const endRange = doc.Range(anchor + latestText.length, anchor + latestText.length);
      forceRefresh(endRange);
    },
    async cancel() {
      if (flushTimer !== null) {
        window.clearTimeout(flushTimer);
        flushTimer = null;
      }

      if (!latestText && replaceSelection && originalText) {
        doc.Range(anchor, anchor).Text = originalText;
      }
    }
  };
}

function normalizeContent(content) {
  if (typeof content === "string") {
    return content;
  }

  if (!Array.isArray(content)) {
    return "";
  }

  return content
    .map((item) => {
      if (typeof item === "string") {
        return item;
      }

      if (item && typeof item === "object" && "text" in item) {
        return String(item.text ?? "");
      }

      return "";
    })
    .join("");
}

function extractChunk(payload) {
  const choice = payload?.choices?.[0];

  return (
    normalizeContent(choice.delta?.content) ||
    normalizeContent(choice.message?.content) ||
    ""
  );
}

+import DOMPurify from "dompurify";
+import { marked } from "marked";
+
+marked.setOptions({
+  async: false,
+  breaks: true,
+  gfm: true
+});
+
+function normalizeMarkdown(markdown) {
+  return String(markdown ?? "").replace(/\r\n/g, "\n");
+}
+
+export function renderMarkdownHtml(markdown) {
+  const source = normalizeMarkdown(markdown).trim();
+  if (!source) {
+    return "";
+  }
+
+  const rawHtml = marked.parse(source);
+  return DOMPurify.sanitize(rawHtml, {
+    USE_PROFILES: { html: true }
+  });
+}
+
+export function createMarkdownDocument(markdown) {
+  const parser = new DOMParser();
+  const html = renderMarkdownHtml(markdown);
+  return parser.parseFromString(html || "<p></p>", "text/html");
+}
+
+export function markdownToPlainText(markdown) {
+  return normalizeMarkdown(markdown)
+    .replace(/```[^\n]*\n?/g, "")
+    .replace(/```/g, "")
+    .replace(/`([^`]+)`/g, "$1")
+    .replace(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\([^)]*\)/g, "$1")
+    .replace(/\[([^\]]+)\]\([^)]*\)/g, "$1")
+    .replace(/^>\s?/gm, "")
+    .replace(/^#{1,6}\s+/gm, "")
+    .replace(/^\s*[-*+]\s+/gm, "\u2022 ")
+    .replace(/^(\s*)\d+\.\s+/gm, "$11. ")
+    .replace(/\*\*([^*]+)\*\*/g, "$1")
+    .replace(/__([^_]+)__/g, "$1")
+    .replace(/\*([^*]+)\*/g, "$1")
+    .replace(/_([^_]+)_/g, "$1")
+    .replace(/~~([^~]+)~~/g, "$1")
+    .replace(/\n{3,}/g, "\n\n")
+    .trim();
+}
```

+function applyTextStyle(range, style) {
+  const font = range.Font;
+
+  font.Bold = style.bold ? 1 : 0;
+  font.Italic = style.italic ? 1 : 0;
+
+  if (style.size) {

+    insertStyledText(state, "\r");
+  }

+function trimTrailingBreaks(state, maxCount = 0) {
+  while (state.trailingBreaks > maxCount && state.length > 0) {
+    const start = state.anchor + state.length - 1;
+    state.doc.Range(start, start + 1).Text = "";
+    state.length -= 1;
+    state.trailingBreaks -= 1;
+  }

+function renderInlineChildren(node, state, style) {
+  for (const child of Array.from(node.childNodes)) {
+    renderNode(child, state, style);
+  }

+function renderListItem(node, state, marker) {

+    if (child.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE && child.tagName === "P") {

+export function detectHostLabel() {

+  if (window.wps?.Application) {

+  return Boolean(app?.ActiveDocument);

+export function createStreamingWriter({ replaceSelection }) {
+  const app = getApplication();
+  if (!app?.ActiveDocument) {
+    return {
+      locationLabel: "Preview only",
+      finish() {},
+      update() {},
+      cancel() {}
+    };
+  }
+
+  const doc = app.ActiveDocument;
+  const selectionRange = getSelectionRange(app);
+
+  if (!selectionRange) {
+    throw new Error("Unable to access the current selection.");
+  }
+
+  const start = Number(selectionRange.Start);
+  const end = Number(selectionRange.End);
+  const originalText = String(selectionRange.Text || "");
+  const anchor = replaceSelection ? start : end;
+  let currentLength = 0;
+  let flushedMarkdown = "";
+  let pendingMarkdown = "";
+  let latestPlainText = "";
+  let flushTimer = null;
+  let flushing = false;
+
+  if (replaceSelection && end > start) {
+    selectionRange.Text = "";
+  }
+
+  function replaceInsertedText(text) {
+    const target = doc.Range(anchor, anchor + currentLength);
+    target.Text = text;
+    currentLength = text.length;
+    latestPlainText = text;
+  }
+
+  async function flushNow() {
+    if (flushing || flushedMarkdown === pendingMarkdown) {
+      return;
+    }
+
+    flushing = true;
+    try {
+      const nextMarkdown = pendingMarkdown;
+      const nextPlainText = markdownToPlainText(nextMarkdown);
+
+      if (nextPlainText !== latestPlainText) {
+        replaceInsertedText(nextPlainText);
+      }
+
+      flushedMarkdown = nextMarkdown;
+    } finally {
+      flushing = false;
+    }
+  }
+
+  return {
+    locationLabel: replaceSelection ? "Replace selection" : "Insert at cursor",
+    update(markdown) {
+      pendingMarkdown = markdown;
+      if (flushTimer !== null) {
+        return;
+      }
+
+      flushTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
+        flushTimer = null;
+        void flushNow();
+      }, 120);
+    },
+    async finish(markdown = pendingMarkdown) {
+      pendingMarkdown = markdown;
+
+      if (flushTimer !== null) {
+        window.clearTimeout(flushTimer);
+        flushTimer = null;
+      }
+
+      await flushNow();
+
+      try {
+        const target = doc.Range(anchor, anchor + currentLength);

+        if (String(markdown ?? "").trim()) {

+        window.clearTimeout(flushTimer);

+      }

+
+function normalizeMaxTokens(value) {
+  if (value === "" || value === null || value === undefined) {
+    return "";
+  }
+
+  if (value === 4096 || value === "4096") {
+    return "";
+  }
+
+  const parsed = Number(value);
+  if (!Number.isFinite(parsed) || parsed <= 0) {
+    return "";
+  }
+
+  return String(Math.floor(parsed));
+}

+export function normalizeSettings(input) {
+  const settings = { ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS, ...input };
+
+  if (
+    settings.providerId === "nvidia" &&
+    (!settings.baseUrl || settings.baseUrl === PROVIDERS.nvidia.directBaseUrl)
+  ) {
+    settings.baseUrl = PROVIDERS.nvidia.defaultBaseUrl;
+  }
+
+  settings.maxTokens = normalizeMaxTokens(settings.maxTokens);
+  return settings;
+}
+
+function normalizeContent(content) {
+  if (typeof content === "string") {
+    return content;
+  }
+
+  if (!Array.isArray(content)) {
+    return "";
+  }
+
+  return content
+    .map((item) => {
+      if (typeof item === "string") {
+        return item;
+      }
+
+      if (item && typeof item === "object" && "text" in item) {
+        return String(item.text ?? "");
+      }
+
+      return "";
+    })
+    .join("");
+}

+function extractChunk(payload) {
+  const choice = payload?.choices?.[0];
+  if (!choice) {
+    return "";
+  }
+
+  return (
+    normalizeContent(choice.delta?.content) ||
+    normalizeContent(choice.message?.content) ||
+    ""
+  );
+}

+  const contentType = response.headers.get("content-type") ?? "";
+
+  try {
+    if (contentType.includes("application/json")) {
+      const json = await response.json();
+      return json?.error?.message || JSON.stringify(json);
+    }
+
+    return await response.text();
+  } catch {

+  }

+  if (Number(settings.maxTokens) > 0) {

+
+  return payload;

+
+function parseSseEvent(block) {
+  const data = block
+    .split(/\r?\n/)
+    .filter((line) => line.startsWith("data:"))
+    .map((line) => line.slice(5).trim())
+    .join("\n")
+    .trim();
+
+  if (!data || data === "[DONE]") {
+    return null;
+  }
+
+  try {
+    return JSON.parse(data);
+  } catch {
+    return null;
+  }
+}

+}

+          selectionText.trim(),
+          "---- 选区结束 ----",
+          ""
+        ].join("\n")
+      : "";
+
+  return [
+    {
+      role: "system",
+      content: settings.systemPrompt.trim()
+    },
+    {
+      role: "user",
+      content: `${selectionBlock}${prompt.trim()}`
+    }
+  ];
+}
+
+export async function* streamCompletion({ settings, messages, signal }) {
+  const headers = {
+    "Content-Type": "application/json",
+    Authorization: `Bearer ${settings.apiKey.trim()}`
+  };
+
+  if (settings.providerId === "openrouter") {
+    headers["HTTP-Referer"] = settings.referer.trim() || "https://localhost";
+    headers["X-Title"] = settings.title.trim() || "WPS AI";
+  }
+
+  let response;
+  try {
+    response = await fetch(`${settings.baseUrl.replace(/\/+$/, "")}/chat/completions`, {
+      method: "POST",
+      headers,
+      body: JSON.stringify(createRequestBody(settings, messages)),
+      signal
+    });
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (settings.providerId === "nvidia") {
+      throw new Error(getNvidiaConnectionError(settings));
+    }
+
+    throw error;
+  }
+
+  if (!response.ok) {
+    throw new Error(await buildError(response));
+  }
+
+  if (!response.body) {
+    const json = await response.json();
+    const fallbackText = extractChunk(json);
+    if (fallbackText) {
+      yield fallbackText;
+    }
+    return;
+  }
+
+  const contentType = response.headers.get("content-type") ?? "";
+  if (!contentType.includes("text/event-stream")) {
+    const json = await response.json();
+    const fallbackText = extractChunk(json);
+    if (fallbackText) {
+      yield fallbackText;
+    }
+    return;
+  }
+
+  const reader = response.body.getReader();
+  const decoder = new TextDecoder();
+  let buffer = "";
+
+  while (true) {
+    const { value, done } = await reader.read();
+
+    if (done) {
+      buffer += decoder.decode();
+      break;
+    }
+
+    buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
+    const parts = buffer.split(/\r?\n\r?\n/);
+    buffer = parts.pop() ?? "";
+
+    for (const part of parts) {
+      const payload = parseSseEvent(part);
+      const text = extractChunk(payload);
+      if (text) {
+        yield text;
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  if (!buffer.trim()) {
+    return;
+  }
+
+  const payload = parseSseEvent(buffer);
+  const text = extractChunk(payload);
+  if (text) {
+    yield text;
+  }

+    setMessages((current) => [

+        startTransition(() => {

+            )
+          );
+        });
+      }

+      await writer.finish(aggregate);
+      setMessages((current) =>

const STORAGE_KEY = "wps_ai_taskpane_id";

function getDockRightValue() {
  if (window.Application?.Enum?.msoCTPDockPositionRight !== undefined) {
    return window.Application.Enum.msoCTPDockPositionRight;
  }

  return 2;
}

function getTaskPaneUrl() {
  return new URL("./taskpane.html", window.location.href).href;
}

function ensureTaskPane() {
  const storage = window.Application.PluginStorage;
  const existingId = storage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);

  if (existingId) {
    try {
      const existing = window.Application.GetTaskPane(existingId);
      if (existing) {
        return existing;
      }
    } catch {
      storage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    }
  }

  const taskPane = window.Application.CreateTaskPane(getTaskPaneUrl());
  storage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, taskPane.ID);
  taskPane.DockPosition = getDockRightValue();
  return taskPane;
}

const ribbon = {
  OnAddinLoad(ribbonUI) {
    if (typeof window.Application.ribbonUI !== "object") {
      window.Application.ribbonUI = ribbonUI;
    }

    return true;
  },

  OnAction(control) {
    const doc = window.Application?.ActiveDocument;
    if (!doc) {
      alert("褰撳墠娌℃湁鎵撳紑浠讳綍鏂囧瓧鏂囨。銆?);
      return true;
    }

    const taskPane = ensureTaskPane();

    switch (control.Id) {
      case "btnToggleTaskPane":
        taskPane.Visible = !taskPane.Visible;
        break;
      case "btnFocusTaskPane":
        taskPane.Visible = true;
        break;
      default:
        break;
    }

    return true;
  },

  GetImage(control) {
    if (control.Id === "btnFocusTaskPane") {
      return "images/ai-stream.svg";
    }

    return "images/ai-pane.svg";
  },

  OnGetEnabled() {
    return Boolean(window.Application?.ActiveDocument);
  }
};

export default ribbon;

import { spawn } from "node:child_process";
import { createServer } from "node:http";

const PORT = 3888;
const NVIDIA_UPSTREAM = "https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1/chat/completions";
const CURL_BIN = process.platform === "win32" ? "curl.exe" : "curl";

function setCorsHeaders(res) {
  res.setHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*");
  res.setHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "GET,POST,OPTIONS");
  res.setHeader("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "authorization,content-type");
}

function sendJson(res, statusCode, payload) {
  setCorsHeaders(res);
  res.writeHead(statusCode, { "Content-Type": "application/json; charset=utf-8" });
  res.end(JSON.stringify(payload));
}

async function readJsonBody(req) {
  const chunks = [];
  for await (const chunk of req) {
    chunks.push(chunk);
  }

  const raw = Buffer.concat(chunks).toString("utf8");
  if (!raw) {
    return {};
  }

  return JSON.parse(raw);
}

function formatCurlFailure(stderr) {
  const message = stderr.trim();
  if (!message) {
    return "Failed to reach NVIDIA upstream";
  }

  return message.replace(/^curl:\s*/i, "");
}

function createCurlArgs(authorization) {
  return [
    "-sS",
    "-N",
    "-f",
    "-X",
    "POST",
    "-H",
    `Authorization: ${authorization}`,
    "-H",
    "Content-Type: application/json",
    "--data-binary",
    "@-",
    NVIDIA_UPSTREAM
  ];
}

async function handleNvidiaChat(req, res) {
  const authorization = req.headers.authorization;
  if (!authorization) {
    sendJson(res, 400, {
      error: {
        message: "Missing Authorization header"
      }
    });
    return;
  }

  let body;
  try {
    body = await readJsonBody(req);
  } catch {
    sendJson(res, 400, {
      error: {
        message: "Invalid JSON body"
      }
    });
    return;
  }

  const curl = spawn(CURL_BIN, createCurlArgs(authorization), {
    stdio: ["pipe", "pipe", "pipe"],
    windowsHide: true
  });

  let stderr = "";
  let streamStarted = false;
  let finished = false;

  function fail(message) {
    if (finished) {
      return;
    }

    finished = true;
    if (!res.headersSent) {
      sendJson(res, 502, { error: { message } });
      return;
    }

    res.end();
  }

  curl.on("error", (error) => {
    fail(error instanceof Error ? error.message : "Failed to start curl");
  });

  curl.stderr.on("data", (chunk) => {
    stderr += chunk.toString("utf8");
  });

  curl.stdout.on("data", (chunk) => {
    if (finished) {
      return;
    }

    if (!streamStarted) {
      setCorsHeaders(res);
      res.writeHead(200, {
        "Content-Type": "text/event-stream; charset=utf-8",
        "Cache-Control": "no-cache"
      });
      streamStarted = true;
    }

    res.write(chunk);
  });

  curl.stdout.on("end", () => {
    if (finished) {
      return;
    }

    finished = true;
    res.end();
  });

  curl.on("close", (code) => {
    if (finished) {
      return;
    }

    if (!streamStarted) {
      fail(formatCurlFailure(stderr || `curl exited with code ${code ?? "unknown"}`));
      return;
    }

    finished = true;
    res.end();
  });

  req.on("aborted", () => {
    if (!finished) {
      curl.kill();
    }
  });

  curl.stdin.end(JSON.stringify(body));
}

const server = createServer(async (req, res) => {
  if (!req.url) {
    sendJson(res, 404, { error: { message: "Not found" } });
    return;
  }

  if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {
    setCorsHeaders(res);
    res.writeHead(204);
    res.end();
    return;
  }

  if (req.method === "GET" && req.url === "/health") {
    sendJson(res, 200, {
      ok: true,
      provider: "nvidia-relay",
      transport: "curl"
    });
    return;
  }

  if (req.method === "POST" && req.url === "/nvidia/v1/chat/completions") {
    await handleNvidiaChat(req, res);
    return;
  }

  sendJson(res, 404, { error: { message: "Not found" } });
});

server.listen(PORT, "127.0.0.1", () => {
  console.log(`WPS AI relay listening on http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}`);
});
```

# Browser Automation with browser-use CLI

The `browser-use` command provides fast, persistent browser automation. A background daemon keeps the browser open across commands, giving ~50ms latency per call.

## Prerequisites

For setup details, see https://github.com/browser-use/browser-use/blob/main/browser_use/skill_cli/README.md

## Core Workflow

1. **Navigate**: `browser-use open <url>` 鈥?starts browser if needed
2. **Inspect**: `browser-use state` 鈥?returns clickable elements with indices
3. **Interact**: use indices from state (`browser-use click 5`, `browser-use input 3 "text"`)
4. **Verify**: `browser-use state` or `browser-use screenshot` to confirm
5. **Repeat**: browser stays open between commands
6. **Cleanup**: `browser-use close` when done

## Browser Modes

```bash
browser-use open <url>                         # Default: headless Chromium
browser-use --headed open <url>                # Visible window
browser-use --profile "Default" open <url>      # Real Chrome with Default profile (existing logins/cookies)
browser-use --profile "Profile 1" open <url>   # Real Chrome with named profile
browser-use --connect open <url>               # Auto-discover running Chrome via CDP
browser-use --cdp-url ws://localhost:9222/... open <url>  # Connect via CDP URL
```

`--connect`, `--cdp-url`, and `--profile` are mutually exclusive.

## Commands

```bash
# Navigation
browser-use open <url>                    # Navigate to URL
browser-use back                          # Go back in history
browser-use scroll down                   # Scroll down (--amount N for pixels)
browser-use scroll up                     # Scroll up
browser-use switch <tab>                  # Switch to tab by index
browser-use close-tab [tab]              # Close tab (current if no index)

# Page State 鈥?always run state first to get element indices
browser-use state                         # URL, title, clickable elements with indices
browser-use screenshot [path.png]         # Screenshot (base64 if no path, --full for full page)

# Interactions 鈥?use indices from state
browser-use click <index>                 # Click element by index
browser-use click <x> <y>                 # Click at pixel coordinates
browser-use type "text"                   # Type into focused element
browser-use input <index> "text"          # Click element, then type
browser-use keys "Enter"                  # Send keyboard keys (also "Control+a", etc.)
browser-use select <index> "option"       # Select dropdown option
browser-use upload <index> <path>         # Upload file to file input
browser-use hover <index>                 # Hover over element
browser-use dblclick <index>              # Double-click element
browser-use rightclick <index>            # Right-click element

# Data Extraction
browser-use eval "js code"                # Execute JavaScript, return result
browser-use get title                     # Page title
browser-use get html [--selector "h1"]    # Page HTML (or scoped to selector)
browser-use get text <index>              # Element text content
browser-use get value <index>             # Input/textarea value
browser-use get attributes <index>        # Element attributes
browser-use get bbox <index>              # Bounding box (x, y, width, height)

# Wait
browser-use wait selector "css"           # Wait for element (--state visible|hidden|attached|detached, --timeout ms)
browser-use wait text "text"              # Wait for text to appear

# Cookies
browser-use cookies get [--url <url>]     # Get cookies (optionally filtered)
browser-use cookies set <name> <value>    # Set cookie (--domain, --secure, --http-only, --same-site, --expires)
browser-use cookies clear [--url <url>]   # Clear cookies
browser-use cookies export <file>         # Export to JSON
browser-use cookies import <file>         # Import from JSON

# Python 鈥?persistent session with browser access
browser-use python "code"                 # Execute Python (variables persist across calls)
browser-use python --file script.py       # Run file
browser-use python --vars                 # Show defined variables
browser-use python --reset                # Clear namespace

# Session
browser-use close                         # Close browser and stop daemon
browser-use sessions                      # List active sessions
browser-use close --all                   # Close all sessions
```

+$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

+$projectRoot = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot

+$addonRoot = Join-Path $env:APPDATA "kingsoft\wps\jsaddons"
+
+if (!(Test-Path $packageJsonPath)) {
+  throw "package.json not found."
+}
+
+if (!(Test-Path $buildDir)) {
+  throw "wps-addon-build not found. Run the build step first."
+}
+
+$package = Get-Content $packageJsonPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
+$addonName = [string]$package.name
+$addonType = [string]$package.addonType
+$addonVersion = [string]$package.version
+$offlineFolderName = "${addonName}_${addonVersion}"
+$offlineTarget = Join-Path $addonRoot $offlineFolderName
+$publishXmlPath = Join-Path $addonRoot "publish.xml"
+
+New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $addonRoot -Force | Out-Null
+Remove-Item $offlineTarget -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
+Copy-Item $buildDir $offlineTarget -Recurse -Force
+
+[xml]$xml = if (Test-Path $publishXmlPath) {
+  Get-Content $publishXmlPath -Raw
+} else {
+  '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><jsplugins />'
+}
+
+if (-not $xml.jsplugins) {
+  $xml.AppendChild($xml.CreateElement("jsplugins")) | Out-Null
+}
+
+$nodesToRemove = @()
+foreach ($node in $xml.jsplugins.ChildNodes) {
+  if ($node.NodeType -ne [System.Xml.XmlNodeType]::Element) {
+    continue
+  }
+
+  if ($node.Attributes["name"] -and $node.Attributes["name"].Value -eq $addonName) {
+    $nodesToRemove += $node
+  }
+}
+
+foreach ($node in $nodesToRemove) {
+  $xml.jsplugins.RemoveChild($node) | Out-Null
+}
+
+$pluginNode = $xml.CreateElement("jsplugin")
+$pluginNode.SetAttribute("name", $addonName)
+$pluginNode.SetAttribute("type", $addonType)
+$pluginNode.SetAttribute("url", $offlineFolderName)
+$pluginNode.SetAttribute("version", $addonVersion)
+$pluginNode.SetAttribute("enable", "enable_dev")
+$pluginNode.SetAttribute("install", "null")
+$pluginNode.SetAttribute("customDomain", "")
+$xml.jsplugins.AppendChild($pluginNode) | Out-Null
+
+$settings = New-Object System.Xml.XmlWriterSettings
+$settings.Indent = $true
+$settings.Encoding = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
+$writer = [System.Xml.XmlWriter]::Create($publishXmlPath, $settings)
+$xml.Save($writer)
+$writer.Close()
+
+Write-Output "Installed addon to $offlineTarget"
+Write-Output "Updated publish.xml at $publishXmlPath"

+function normalizeProxyUrl(value) {
+  const trimmed = String(value ?? "").trim();
+  if (!trimmed) {
+    return "";
+  }
+
+  if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(trimmed)) {
+    return trimmed;
+  }

+  return `http://${trimmed}`;

+function resolveWindowsProxy() {

+    const output = execFileSync(
+      "reg.exe",
+      [
+        "query",
+        "HKCU\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Internet Settings",
+        "/v",
+        "ProxyServer"
+      ],
+      {
+        encoding: "utf8",
+        stdio: ["ignore", "pipe", "ignore"],
+        windowsHide: true
+      }
+    );
+
+    const match = output.match(/ProxyServer\s+REG_\w+\s+(.+)$/im);
+    if (!match) {
+      return "";
+    }

+    const raw = match[1].trim();
+    if (!raw) {

+    }

+        .map((part) => part.trim())
+        .filter(Boolean)
+        .map((part) => {
+          const [key, value] = part.split("=", 2);
+          return [key.toLowerCase(), normalizeProxyUrl(value)];
+        })
+    );
+
+    return map.https || map.http || Object.values(map)[0] || "";
+  } catch {
+    return "";
+  }
+}

+function resolveProxyEnv() {

+    process.env.HTTPS_PROXY ||
+    process.env.HTTP_PROXY ||
+    process.env.https_proxy ||
+    process.env.http_proxy ||
+    (process.platform === "win32" ? resolveWindowsProxy() : "");
+
+  if (!proxy) {
+    return process.env;
+  }
+
+  return {
+    ...process.env,
+    HTTP_PROXY: proxy,
+    HTTPS_PROXY: proxy,
+    http_proxy: proxy,
+    https_proxy: proxy,
+    NO_PROXY: process.env.NO_PROXY || "127.0.0.1,localhost",
+    no_proxy: process.env.no_proxy || "127.0.0.1,localhost"

if (!(Test-Path $packageJsonPath)) {

$publishXmlPath = Join-Path $addonRoot "publish.xml"

Copy-Item $buildDir $offlineTarget -Recurse -Force

[xml]$xml = if (Test-Path $publishXmlPath) {

  '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><jsplugins />'
}

if (-not $xml.DocumentElement) {
  $xml.LoadXml('<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><jsplugins />')
}

$root = $xml.DocumentElement

$nodesToRemove = @()
foreach ($node in $root.ChildNodes) {
  if ($node.NodeType -ne [System.Xml.XmlNodeType]::Element) {
    continue
  }

  if ($node.Attributes["name"] -and $node.Attributes["name"].Value -eq $addonName) {
    $nodesToRemove += $node
  }
}

foreach ($node in $nodesToRemove) {
  $root.RemoveChild($node) | Out-Null
}

$pluginNode = $xml.CreateElement("jsplugin")
$pluginNode.SetAttribute("name", $addonName)
$pluginNode.SetAttribute("type", $addonType)
$pluginNode.SetAttribute("url", $offlineFolderName)
$pluginNode.SetAttribute("version", $addonVersion)
$pluginNode.SetAttribute("enable", "enable_dev")
$pluginNode.SetAttribute("install", "null")
$pluginNode.SetAttribute("customDomain", "")
$root.AppendChild($pluginNode) | Out-Null

$settings = New-Object System.Xml.XmlWriterSettings
$settings.Indent = $true
$settings.Encoding = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
$writer = [System.Xml.XmlWriter]::Create($publishXmlPath, $settings)
$xml.Save($writer)
$writer.Close()

Write-Output "Installed addon to $offlineTarget"
Write-Output "Updated publish.xml at $publishXmlPath"

function normalizeProxyUrl(value) {
  const trimmed = String(value ?? "").trim();
  if (!trimmed) {
    return "";
  }

  if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(trimmed)) {

  }

  return `http://${trimmed}`;

function resolveConfigProxy() {
  try {

      return "";
    }

    const raw = readFileSync(RELAY_CONFIG_URL, "utf8");
    const config = JSON.parse(raw);

    return normalizeProxyUrl(

        config.httpProxy ||
        config.HTTPS_PROXY ||
        config.HTTP_PROXY ||

    );

  }
}

function resolveWindowsProxy() {
  try {

      "reg.exe",
      [
        "query",
        "HKCU\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Internet Settings",
        "/v",
        "ProxyServer"
      ],
      {
        encoding: "utf8",
        stdio: ["ignore", "pipe", "ignore"],
        windowsHide: true
      }
    );

    const match = output.match(/ProxyServer\s+REG_\w+\s+(.+)$/im);
    if (!match) {
      return "";
    }

    const raw = match[1].trim();
    if (!raw) {
      return "";
    }

    if (!raw.includes("=")) {
      return normalizeProxyUrl(raw);
    }

    const map = Object.fromEntries(
      raw
        .split(";")
        .map((part) => part.trim())
        .filter(Boolean)
        .map((part) => {
          const [key, value] = part.split("=", 2);
          return [key.toLowerCase(), normalizeProxyUrl(value)];
        })
    );

    return map.https || map.http || Object.values(map)[0] || "";
  } catch {
    return "";
  }
}

function resolveProxyEnv() {
  const proxy =
    resolveConfigProxy() ||
    process.env.HTTPS_PROXY ||
    process.env.HTTP_PROXY ||
    process.env.https_proxy ||

  const existingId = storage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);

  if (existingId) {
    try {
      const existing = window.Application.GetTaskPane(existingId);
      if (existing) {
        return existing;
      }
    } catch {
      storage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    }
  }

  const taskPane = window.Application.CreateTaskPane(getTaskPaneUrl());
  storage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, taskPane.ID);
  taskPane.DockPosition = getDockRightValue();
  return taskPane;
}

const ribbon = {
  OnAddinLoad(ribbonUI) {
    if (typeof window.Application.ribbonUI !== "object") {
      window.Application.ribbonUI = ribbonUI;
    }

    return true;
  },

  OnAction(control) {
    const doc = window.Application?.ActiveDocument;
    if (!doc) {
      alert("褰撳墠娌℃湁鎵撳紑浠讳綍鏂囧瓧鏂囨。銆?);
      return true;
    }

    const taskPane = ensureTaskPane();

    switch (control.Id) {
      case "btnToggleTaskPane":
        taskPane.Visible = !taskPane.Visible;
        break;
      case "btnFocusTaskPane":
        taskPane.Visible = true;
        break;
      default:
        break;
    }

    return true;
  },

  GetImage(control) {
    if (control.Id === "btnFocusTaskPane") {
      return "images/ai-stream.svg";
    }

    return "images/ai-pane.svg";
  },

  OnGetEnabled() {
    return Boolean(window.Application?.ActiveDocument);
  }
};

export default ribbon;
```

import DOMPurify from "dompurify";
import { marked } from "marked";

marked.setOptions({
  async: false,
  breaks: true,
  gfm: true
});

function normalizeMarkdown(markdown) {
  return String(markdown ?? "").replace(/\r\n/g, "\n");
}

export function renderMarkdownHtml(markdown) {
  const source = normalizeMarkdown(markdown).trim();
  if (!source) {
    return "";
  }

  const rawHtml = marked.parse(source);
  return DOMPurify.sanitize(rawHtml, {
    USE_PROFILES: { html: true }
  });
}

export function createMarkdownDocument(markdown) {
  const parser = new DOMParser();
  const html = renderMarkdownHtml(markdown);
  return parser.parseFromString(html || "<p></p>", "text/html");
}

export function markdownToPlainText(markdown) {
  return normalizeMarkdown(markdown)
    .replace(/```[^\n]*\n?/g, "")
    .replace(/```/g, "")
    .replace(/`([^`]+)`/g, "$1")
    .replace(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\([^)]*\)/g, "$1")
    .replace(/\[([^\]]+)\]\([^)]*\)/g, "$1")
    .replace(/^>\s?/gm, "")
    .replace(/^#{1,6}\s+/gm, "")
    .replace(/^\s*[-*+]\s+/gm, "\u2022 ")
    .replace(/^(\s*)\d+\.\s+/gm, (_, indent) => `${indent}1. `)
    .replace(/\*\*([^*]+)\*\*/g, "$1")
    .replace(/__([^_]+)__/g, "$1")
    .replace(/\*([^*]+)\*/g, "$1")
    .replace(/_([^_]+)_/g, "$1")
    .replace(/~~([^~]+)~~/g, "$1")
    .replace(/\n{3,}/g, "\n\n")
    .trim();
}

async function startServer(serverPort){

    bSuccess = await debugVite('dev', serverPort)

function startNormalServer(serverPort){
    //濡傛灉涓嶆槸浣跨敤鐨剉ue/react, 鐩存帴鍚姩server
    const app = express()
    const clients = []
        
    let rootPath = process.cwd()
    app.all('*', function (req, response, next) {
        if (req.originalUrl.endsWith(".html") || req.originalUrl.endsWith(".htm")) {
            let filePath = rootPath + req.originalUrl
            var htmlData = fsEx.readFileSync(filePath)
            let pos = htmlData.indexOf("<body")
            if (pos == -1)
                pos = htmlData.indexOf("<script")
            if (pos == -1) {
                pos = htmlData.indexOf("<html>")
                pos += 6
            }
            htmlData = htmlData.slice(0, pos) + `<script type="text/javascript" src="./hot-update-inject.js"></script>` + htmlData.slice(pos)
            response.writeHead(200, "OK", { "Content-Type": "text/html" })
            response.end(htmlData)
        } else if (req.originalUrl.endsWith("/hot-update-inject.js")) {
            response.writeHead(200, "OK", { "Content-Type": "application/javascript; charset=utf-8" })
            const inject =
                `function handleMessage(event) {
                    var res = JSON.parse(event.data)
                    if (res.update)
                        window.location.reload()
                }

                function handleOnline(event) {
                }

                function handleDisconnect(event) {
                    source.close();;
                }

                var source = new window.EventSource('${serverHost}/hot-update/${Math.random()}');
                source.onopen = handleOnline;
                source.onerror = handleDisconnect;
                source.onmessage = handleMessage;`
            response.end(inject)
        } else {
            next();
        }
    });
    app.use(express.static(rootPath))
    app.use("/publish.xml", function (request, response) {
        response.writeHead(200, "OK", { "Content-Type": "text/xml" })
        response.end("")
    });
    app.use("/hot-update/:id", function (request, response) {
        response.writeHead(200, "OK", { 'Connection': 'keep-alive', "Content-Type": "text/event-stream", 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache' })
        clients.push(response)
    });

    var server = app.listen(serverPort, function () {
        console.log(jsUtil.getNow() + `鍚姩鏈湴web鏈嶅姟(${serverHost})鎴愬姛锛乣)

            let nowTime = new Date()
            if (nowTime.getTime() - lastTime.getTime() > 300) {
                lastTime = nowTime;

                });

        })

+function normalizeContent(content) {

+
+  return content

+      if (item && typeof item === "object" && "text" in item) {

+    }
+

+function parseSseEvent(block) {
+  const data = block
+    .split(/\r?\n/)
+    .filter((line) => line.startsWith("data:"))
+    .map((line) => line.slice(5).trim())
+    .join("\n")
+    .trim();
+
+  if (!data || data === "[DONE]") {
+    return null;
+  }
+
+  try {

+  } catch {

+  }

+  }
+
+  return "当前 WPS 前端无法直接连接 NVIDIA。请使用本地中转地址。";
+}
+
+function getNvidiaTimeoutError(settings) {
+  const seconds = Math.max(
+    1,
+    Math.round(Number(settings.firstTokenTimeoutMs || 0) / 1000)
+  );
+
+  return `模型 ${settings.model.trim() || "deepseek-ai/deepseek-v3.1-terminus"} 在 ${seconds} 秒内没有返回首包。当前不会自动切换模型，请稍后重试。`;
+}
+
+function createRequestController(signal) {
+  const controller = new AbortController();
+
+  if (signal) {
+    if (signal.aborted) {
+      controller.abort();
+    } else {
+      signal.addEventListener("abort", () => controller.abort(), {
+        once: true
+      });
+    }
+  }
+
+  return controller;
+}

+export function buildMessages({ prompt, selectionText, settings }) {
+  const selectionBlock =
+    settings.useSelectionAsContext && selectionText.trim()
+      ? [
+          "The following text is the current WPS selection. Use it as context, but do not mechanically repeat it.",
+          "",
+          "---- Selection Start ----",
+          selectionText.trim(),
+          "---- Selection End ----",
+          ""
+        ].join("\n")
+      : "";
+
+  return [
+    {
+      role: "system",
+      content: settings.systemPrompt.trim()
+    },
+    {
+      role: "user",
+      content: `${selectionBlock}${prompt.trim()}`
+    }
+  ];
+}
+
+export async function* streamCompletion({ settings, messages, signal }) {
+  const headers = {
+    "Content-Type": "application/json",
+    Authorization: `Bearer ${settings.apiKey.trim()}`
+  };
+
+  if (settings.providerId === "openrouter") {
+    headers["HTTP-Referer"] = settings.referer.trim() || "https://localhost";
+    headers["X-Title"] = settings.title.trim() || "WPS AI";
+  }
+
+  let response;
+  const requestController = createRequestController(signal);
+  let timedOutBeforeFirstChunk = false;
+  let firstChunkTimeoutId = null;
+
+  if (settings.providerId === "nvidia") {
+    firstChunkTimeoutId = window.setTimeout(() => {
+      timedOutBeforeFirstChunk = true;
+      requestController.abort();
+    }, normalizeFirstTokenTimeout(settings.firstTokenTimeoutMs));
+  }
+
+  try {
+    await waitForLocalRelay(settings, signal);
+    response = await fetch(
+      `${settings.baseUrl.replace(/\/+$/, "")}/chat/completions`,
+      {
+        method: "POST",
+        headers,
+        body: JSON.stringify(createRequestBody(settings, messages)),
+        signal: requestController.signal
+      }
+    );
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (firstChunkTimeoutId !== null) {
+      window.clearTimeout(firstChunkTimeoutId);
+    }
+
+    if (timedOutBeforeFirstChunk && settings.providerId === "nvidia") {
+      throw new Error(getNvidiaTimeoutError(settings));
+    }
+
+    if (settings.providerId === "nvidia") {
+      throw new Error(getNvidiaConnectionError(settings));
+    }
+
+    throw error;
+  }
+
+  if (!response.ok) {
+    throw new Error(await buildError(response));
+  }
+
+  if (!response.body) {
+    if (firstChunkTimeoutId !== null) {
+      window.clearTimeout(firstChunkTimeoutId);
+    }
+
+    const json = await response.json();
+    const fallbackText = extractChunk(json);
+    if (fallbackText) {
+      yield fallbackText;
+    }
+    return;
+  }
+
+  const contentType = response.headers.get("content-type") ?? "";
+  if (!contentType.includes("text/event-stream")) {
+    if (firstChunkTimeoutId !== null) {
+      window.clearTimeout(firstChunkTimeoutId);
+    }
+
+    const json = await response.json();
+    const fallbackText = extractChunk(json);
+    if (fallbackText) {
+      yield fallbackText;
+    }
+    return;
+  }
+
+  const reader = response.body.getReader();
+  const decoder = new TextDecoder();
+  let buffer = "";
+  let receivedFirstChunk = false;
+
+  while (true) {
+    let result;
+
+    try {
+      result = await reader.read();
+    } catch (error) {
+      if (firstChunkTimeoutId !== null) {
+        window.clearTimeout(firstChunkTimeoutId);
+      }
+
+      if (timedOutBeforeFirstChunk && settings.providerId === "nvidia") {
+        throw new Error(getNvidiaTimeoutError(settings));
+      }
+
+      throw error;
+    }
+
+    const { value, done } = result;
+
+    if (!receivedFirstChunk && (done || (value && value.length > 0))) {
+      receivedFirstChunk = true;
+      if (firstChunkTimeoutId !== null) {
+        window.clearTimeout(firstChunkTimeoutId);
+        firstChunkTimeoutId = null;
+      }
+    }
+
+    if (done) {
+      buffer += decoder.decode();
+      break;
+    }
+
+    buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
+    const parts = buffer.split(/\r?\n\r?\n/);
+    buffer = parts.pop() ?? "";
+
+    for (const part of parts) {
+      const payload = parseSseEvent(part);
+      const text = extractChunk(payload);
+      if (text) {
+        yield text;
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  if (!buffer.trim()) {
+    return;
+  }
+
+  const payload = parseSseEvent(buffer);
+  const text = extractChunk(payload);
+  if (text) {
+    yield text;
+  }
+}

+function normalizeProxyUrl(value) {
+  const trimmed = String(value ?? "").trim();
+  if (!trimmed) {
+    return "";
+  }
+
+  if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(trimmed)) {
+    return trimmed;
+  }
+
+  return `http://${trimmed}`;
+}
+

+    if (!existsSync(RELAY_CONFIG_URL)) {

+    }
+
+    return JSON.parse(readFileSync(RELAY_CONFIG_URL, "utf8"));
+  } catch {

+  }
+}
+
+function resolveConfigProxy(config) {
+  return normalizeProxyUrl(
+    config.proxyUrl ||
+      config.httpsProxy ||
+      config.httpProxy ||
+      config.HTTPS_PROXY ||
+      config.HTTP_PROXY ||
+      ""
+  );
+}
+
+function resolveWindowsProxy() {
+  try {
+    const output = execFileSync(
+      "reg.exe",
+      [
+        "query",
+        "HKCU\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Internet Settings",
+        "/v",
+        "ProxyServer"
+      ],
+      {
+        encoding: "utf8",
+        stdio: ["ignore", "pipe", "ignore"],
+        windowsHide: true
+      }
+    );
+
+    const match = output.match(/ProxyServer\s+REG_\w+\s+(.+)$/im);
+    if (!match) {
+      return "";
+    }
+
+    const raw = match[1].trim();
+    if (!raw) {
+      return "";
+    }
+
+    if (!raw.includes("=")) {
+      return normalizeProxyUrl(raw);
+    }
+
+    const map = Object.fromEntries(
+      raw
+        .split(";")
+        .map((part) => part.trim())
+        .filter(Boolean)
+        .map((part) => {
+          const [key, value] = part.split("=", 2);
+          return [key.toLowerCase(), normalizeProxyUrl(value)];
+        })
+    );
+
+    return map.https || map.http || Object.values(map)[0] || "";
+  } catch {
+    return "";
+  }
+}
+
+function resolveProxyEnv(config) {
+  const proxy =

+  let streamStarted = false;
+  let finished = false;

+  function fail(message) {

+      return;
+    }
+
+    finished = true;

+  });
+
+  curl.stdout.on("data", (chunk) => {
+    if (finished) {
+      return;
+    }
+
+    if (!streamStarted) {
+      setCorsHeaders(res);
+      res.writeHead(200, {
+        "Content-Type": "text/event-stream; charset=utf-8",
+        "Cache-Control": "no-cache"
+      });
+      streamStarted = true;
+    }
+
+    res.write(chunk);
+  });
+
+  curl.stdout.on("end", () => {
+    if (finished) {
+      return;
+    }
+
+    finished = true;
+    res.end();
+  });
+
+  curl.on("close", (code) => {
+    if (finished) {
+      return;
+    }
+
+    if (!streamStarted) {

+      return;
+    }

+    finished = true;

+  });

+    }
+  });

+    res.end();

+  sendJson(res, 404, { error: { message: "Not found" } });

_**Agent (gpt-5.4 2026-04-15 14:55:38Z)**_

不是。至少你现在这个报错，主因不是“没配系统代理”。

我刚实测了 2026-04-15 当前这台机器的状态：

- Windows 系统代理是开启的，`ProxyEnable = 1`
- 系统代理地址就是 `http://proxy.zte.com.cn:80`
- 本地 relay 也明确在走这个代理，`/health` 返回的 `proxy` 也是 `http://proxy.zte.com.cn:80`
- 同一条代理链路下，`meta/llama-3.1-70b-instruct` 能立刻流式返回
- 同一条代理链路下，`deepseek-ai/deepseek-v3.1-terminus` 在 25 秒内 0 字节返回，之前 60 秒测试也是 0 首包

所以结论很直接：

- 代理链路是通的
- 不是“WPS 没走代理”导致的
- 更像是 NVIDIA 那边这个 `deepseek-ai/deepseek-v3.1-terminus` 当前响应很慢，或者排队/冷启动严重

你项目里的代理配置也已经写死在 [relay.config.json](D:/cursor_dev/wps_ai/server/relay.config.json)，relay 也会对前端暴露健康状态，代码在 [relay.mjs](D:/cursor_dev/wps_ai/server/relay.mjs)。

如果你坚持必须用这个 DeepSeek 模型，合理方案只有两个：

- 把首包超时继续拉长，比如改到 300 秒，避免 120 秒就报错
- UI 改成“持续等待中”，一旦首包来了再立刻流式写入 WPS

但这只能避免“过早报错”，不能让它真实变快。真正慢的是上游模型首包。

如果你要，我下一步直接把插件改成：
- DeepSeek 专用超时 300 秒
- 等待时不弹错误，只显示连接中
- 一旦首包到达，立即流式写入 WPS 正文

这样至少使用体验会顺很多。

function normalizeProxyUrl(value) {
  const trimmed = String(value ?? "").trim();
  if (!trimmed) {

  if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(trimmed)) {

  }

  return `http://${trimmed}`;

function resolveConfigProxy(config) {
  return normalizeProxyUrl(
    config.proxyUrl ||

      config.httpProxy ||

      config.HTTP_PROXY ||
      ""
  );
}

function resolveWindowsProxy() {
  try {
    const output = execFileSync(
      "reg.exe",
      [
        "query",
        "HKCU\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Internet Settings",
        "/v",
        "ProxyServer"

      {
        encoding: "utf8",
        stdio: ["ignore", "pipe", "ignore"],
        windowsHide: true
      }
    );

    const match = output.match(/ProxyServer\s+REG_\w+\s+(.+)$/im);
    if (!match) {

    }

    const raw = match[1].trim();

+
+function createModelEntry(item, previous = null) {
+  return {
+    id: item.id,
+    ownedBy: item.ownedBy,
+    benchmark: previous?.benchmark ?? null
+  };
+}
+
+function statusRank(entry, currentModel) {
+  if (entry.id === currentModel) {
+    return -1;
+  }
+
+  switch (entry.benchmark?.status ?? "untested") {
+    case "ok":
+      return 0;
+    case "timeout":
+      return 2;
+    case "unsupported":
+    case "unauthorized":
+      return 3;
+    case "error":
+      return 4;
+    default:
+      return 5;
+  }
+}
+
+function compareModelEntries(left, right, currentModel) {
+  const rankDiff = statusRank(left, currentModel) - statusRank(right, currentModel);
+  if (rankDiff !== 0) {
+    return rankDiff;
+  }
+
+  const leftToken = left.benchmark?.firstTokenMs;
+  const rightToken = right.benchmark?.firstTokenMs;
+
+  if (
+    Number.isFinite(leftToken) &&
+    Number.isFinite(rightToken) &&
+    leftToken !== rightToken
+  ) {
+    return leftToken - rightToken;
+  }
+
+  if (Number.isFinite(leftToken) && !Number.isFinite(rightToken)) {
+    return -1;
+  }
+
+  if (!Number.isFinite(leftToken) && Number.isFinite(rightToken)) {
+    return 1;
+  }
+
+  return left.id.localeCompare(right.id);
+}
+
+function applyBenchmarkResult(entries, result) {
+  return entries.map((entry) =>
+    entry.id === result.model
+      ? {
+          ...entry,
+          benchmark: {
+            status: result.status,
+            ok: Boolean(result.ok),
+            firstByteMs: result.firstByteMs,
+            firstTokenMs: result.firstTokenMs,
+            totalMs: result.totalMs,
+            message: result.message || ""
+          }
+        }
+      : entry
+  );
+}
+
+function formatLatency(value) {
+  if (!Number.isFinite(value)) {
+    return "";
+  }
+
+  return `${Math.round(value)} ms`;
+}
+
+function benchmarkLabel(entry) {
+  switch (entry.benchmark?.status ?? "untested") {
+    case "ok":
+      return entry.benchmark?.firstTokenMs
+        ? `First token ${formatLatency(entry.benchmark.firstTokenMs)}`
+        : "Ready";
+    case "timeout":
+      return "Timeout";
+    case "unsupported":
+      return "Unsupported";
+    case "unauthorized":
+      return "Restricted";
+    case "error":
+      return "Error";
+    default:
+      return "Not tested";
+  }
+}
+
+function benchmarkClassName(entry) {
+  return `status-pill ${entry.benchmark?.status ?? "untested"}`;
+}

_**Agent (gpt-5.4 2026-04-15 15:23:35Z)**_

已经做了，WPS 里现在可以直接拉取 NVIDIA 当前可用模型并一键测速排序，再点 `Use` 选中。模型列表走官方 `GET /v1/models`，测速走本地 relay 并按首个 token 延迟排序；不支持 `chat/completions` 的模型会自动标成 `unsupported`。相关代码在 [ai.js](D:/cursor_dev/wps_ai/src/taskpane/ai.js#L284)、[relay.mjs](D:/cursor_dev/wps_ai/server/relay.mjs#L543)、[relay.mjs](D:/cursor_dev/wps_ai/server/relay.mjs#L682)、[App.jsx](D:/cursor_dev/wps_ai/src/taskpane/App.jsx#L836)、[App.jsx](D:/cursor_dev/wps_ai/src/taskpane/App.jsx#L900)。

我已经重打包并重装到本机，当前离线插件版本是 `1.0.2`，`publish.xml` 也已经切到 `wps-ai_1.0.2`。你现在只需要彻底退出 WPS，再重新打开。进插件后点右上角设置，在 NVIDIA 配置里点 `Model Lab`，然后点 `Benchmark`，等排序完成后直接点某个模型右侧的 `Use` 就行。

补一句关键点：NVIDIA 官方 `/v1/models` 返回的是“你的 key 当前能看到的模型”，它不直接给 `free` 标记。所以我这里采用的是更实用的方案：先取官方模型列表，再用你的真实 key 在你这台机器上实际测速，这比静态“免费标签”更可靠。

if (!(Test-Path $packageJsonPath)) {

if (!(Test-Path $buildDir)) {

}

$package = Get-Content $packageJsonPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$addonName = [string]$package.name
$addonType = [string]$package.addonType
$addonVersion = [string]$package.version
$offlineFolderName = "${addonName}_${addonVersion}"
$offlineTarget = Join-Path $addonRoot $offlineFolderName
$publishXmlPath = Join-Path $addonRoot "publish.xml"

Copy-Item $buildDir $offlineTarget -Recurse -Force

[xml]$xml = if (Test-Path $publishXmlPath) {

} else {
  '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><jsplugins />'
}

if (-not $xml.DocumentElement) {
  $xml.LoadXml('<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><jsplugins />')
}

$root = $xml.DocumentElement

$nodesToRemove = @()
foreach ($node in $root.ChildNodes) {
  if ($node.NodeType -ne [System.Xml.XmlNodeType]::Element) {
    continue
  }

  if ($node.Attributes["name"] -and $node.Attributes["name"].Value -eq $addonName) {
    $nodesToRemove += $node
  }
}

foreach ($node in $nodesToRemove) {
  $root.RemoveChild($node) | Out-Null
}

$pluginNode = $xml.CreateElement("jsplugin")
$pluginNode.SetAttribute("name", $addonName)
$pluginNode.SetAttribute("type", $addonType)
$pluginNode.SetAttribute("url", $offlineFolderName)
$pluginNode.SetAttribute("version", $addonVersion)
$pluginNode.SetAttribute("enable", "enable_dev")
$pluginNode.SetAttribute("install", "null")
$pluginNode.SetAttribute("customDomain", "")
$root.AppendChild($pluginNode) | Out-Null

$settings = New-Object System.Xml.XmlWriterSettings
$settings.Indent = $true
$settings.Encoding = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
$writer = [System.Xml.XmlWriter]::Create($publishXmlPath, $settings)
$xml.Save($writer)
$writer.Close()

New-Item -Path $runKeyPath -Force | Out-Null
Set-ItemProperty -Path $runKeyPath -Name $runValueName -Value "wscript.exe `"$runVbsPath`""

& powershell -WindowStyle Hidden -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "start-relay.ps1")

Write-Output "Installed addon to $offlineTarget"
Write-Output "Updated publish.xml at $publishXmlPath"
Write-Output "Registered relay auto-start in $runKeyPath"

function resolveWindowsProxy() {
  try {
    const output = execFileSync(
      "reg.exe",
      [
        "query",
        "HKCU\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Internet Settings",
        "/v",
        "ProxyServer"
      ],
      {

        stdio: ["ignore", "pipe", "ignore"],

    const match = output.match(/ProxyServer\s+REG_\w+\s+(.+)$/im);

    const map = Object.fromEntries(
      raw

        .filter(Boolean)

  } catch {
    return "";

  if (!proxy) {

import DOMPurify from "dompurify";
import { marked } from "marked";

marked.setOptions({
  async: false,
  breaks: true,
  gfm: true
});

function normalizeMarkdown(markdown) {
  return String(markdown ?? "").replace(/\r\n/g, "\n");
}

export function renderMarkdownHtml(markdown) {
  const source = normalizeMarkdown(markdown).trim();
  if (!source) {
    return "";
  }

  const rawHtml = marked.parse(source);
  return DOMPurify.sanitize(rawHtml, {
    USE_PROFILES: { html: true }
  });
}

export function createMarkdownDocument(markdown) {
  const parser = new DOMParser();
  const html = renderMarkdownHtml(markdown);
  return parser.parseFromString(html || "<p></p>", "text/html");
}

export function markdownToPlainText(markdown) {
  return normalizeMarkdown(markdown)
    .replace(/```[^\n]*\n?/g, "")
    .replace(/```/g, "")
    .replace(/`([^`]+)`/g, "$1")
    .replace(/!\[([^\]]*)\]\([^)]*\)/g, "$1")
    .replace(/\[([^\]]+)\]\([^)]*\)/g, "$1")
    .replace(/^>\s?/gm, "")
    .replace(/^#{1,6}\s+/gm, "")
    .replace(/^\s*[-*+]\s+/gm, "\u2022 ")
    .replace(/^(\s*)\d+\.\s+/gm, (_, indent) => `${indent}1. `)
    .replace(/\*\*([^*]+)\*\*/g, "$1")
    .replace(/__([^_]+)__/g, "$1")
    .replace(/\*([^*]+)\*/g, "$1")
    .replace(/_([^_]+)_/g, "$1")
    .replace(/~~([^~]+)~~/g, "$1")
    .replace(/\n{3,}/g, "\n\n")
    .trim();
}

}

async function buildWithArgs(answers) {
    return new Promise((r,j)=>{
        let debugTemp = jsUtil.GetDebugTempPath(true);
        fsEx.removeSync(debugTemp)
    
        let curDir = process.cwd()
        let buildDir = curDir
        if (projectCfg.scripts && typeof projectCfg.scripts.build == 'string') {
            let buildCmd = projectCfg.scripts.build.trim();
            if (buildCmd.includes("vite")) {
                buildDir = require('./buildvue')(answers)
            } else if (buildCmd.includes("react-scripts")) {
                buildDir = require('./buildreact')(answers)
            }
        }
        let publishRoot = path.resolve(curDir, jsUtil.GetPublishDir());
        fsEx.removeSync(publishRoot);
        let buildRoot = path.resolve(curDir, buildDirectory);
        let distPath = buildRoot
        if (answers.pluginType == "offline")
            distPath = path.resolve(buildRoot, `${projectCfg.name}_${projectCfg.version}`)
        fsEx.removeSync(buildRoot)
        fs.readdir(buildDir, (_, files) => {
            files.forEach(file => {
                if (file != buildDirectory && file != "node_modules" &&
                    file != ".vscode" && file != ".git" &&
                    file != "package.json" && file != "package-lock.json") {
                    const srcPath = path.resolve(buildDir, file)
                    fsEx.copySync(srcPath, path.resolve(distPath, file))
                }
            })
    
            if (answers.pluginType == "offline") {
                let path7z = path.resolve(buildRoot, `${projectCfg.name}.7z`)
                let inputPaths = [distPath]

                    recursive: false,
                    $bin: _7zBin.path7za
                  });
                stream7z.on('end', ()=>{
                    fsEx.removeSync(distPath)
                })                
            }

            const buildResultDir = path.resolve(process.cwd(), buildDirectory)
            r(buildResultDir)
        })
    })
}

async function buildwithSelfArchive(){

        let buildRoot = path.resolve(curDir, 'dist')
        if (!projectCfg.scripts){

        }
       
        let exePath = path.resolve(buildDir, `${projectCfg.name}.exe`)
        createSelfExtractingExe(buildDir, buildRoot, exePath)
    })
}

    ws.write(configFileBuffer);

    let path7z = path.resolve(buildDir, `${projectCfg.name}.7z`)
    ws.write(fs.readFileSync(path7z));
    ws.end(()=>{fsEx.removeSync(path7z)});
  
    console.log('Self-extracting EXE created:', outputFile);
  }

_**Agent (gpt-5.4 2026-04-15 16:17:40Z)**_

我先联网查两类资料：一类是 WPS/Word 这类编辑器能不能对 `Range` 做真正的流式样式写入，另一类是现成的“流式 Markdown 解析器”能不能直接接进我们现在的插件。查到可用方案后我会直接判断哪种最稳。

_**Agent (gpt-5.4 2026-04-15 16:20:24Z)**_

查了，结论很直接：

没有“现成可直接塞进 WPS 正文、还能像 ChatGPT 一样实时格式化”的完美成品。现成库基本都只解决“网页里的流式 Markdown 渲染”，不解决 “WPS 文档 Range/Selection 怎么同步落格式” 这半截。

最接近可落地的方案是：

1. 用一个真正的“流式 Markdown 解析器”替掉我们现在的“纯文本流式 + 结束后补格式”。
2. 同一份 token 流同时驱动两端：
   - 右侧对话框：直接实时渲染
   - WPS 正文：按 token 实时插入并立刻给对应 Range 设置字体/段落格式
3. 对 WPS 里特别难实时完美处理的块级结构，只修“最后一个未闭合块”，不要重写整篇。

我看下来，最适合我们项目的现成库是 `streaming-markdown`，不是 `streamdown`。

原因：
- [`streaming-markdown`](https://github.com/thetarnav/streaming-markdown) 本身就是为流式 Markdown 做的，支持 `parser_write` / `parser_end`，而且最关键的是它提供自定义 renderer 接口：`add_token`、`end_token`、`add_text`、`set_attr`。这正适合接一个“WPS renderer”。
- 它还是“乐观解析”，未闭合的代码块、粗体、斜体也会先按正在形成的样子渲染，这和你要的“实时格式化”最接近。
- [`streamdown`](https://github.com/vercel/streamdown) 很强，但它是 React DOM 组件路线，更适合右侧聊天框，不适合直接驱动 WPS 文档正文。
- [`@nlux/markdown`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/%40nlux/markdown) 和 [`Incremark`](https://www.incremark.com/) 也偏 DOM 渲染，不是为 WPS 文档 API 设计的。

WPS 这边官方能力我也确认了：
- 可以实时插文本：[`Selection.InsertAfter(Text)`](https://solution.wps.cn/docs/client/api/Word/Selection.html)
- 可以对指定范围实时设字体：[`Range.Font`](https://solution.wps.cn/docs/client/api/Word/Font.html)
- 可以对指定范围设段落格式：[`Range.ParagraphFormat`](https://solution.wps.cn/docs/client/api/Word/ParagraphFormat.html)
- 也能把带格式 HTML 贴进文档：[`Range.PasteHtml({ HTML })`](https://solution.wps.cn/docs/client/api/Word/Range.html)
- WPS 官方还明确说了：大量带格式内容继续靠 `Range.Text` 一个个写，“非常耗时而且极其容易出错”，推荐用 `PasteHtml` 做批量带格式插入：[`批量插入数据` demo](https://solution.wps.cn/docs/demo/word/bulk-fill-data.html)

所以真正最稳的工程方案是：

- 右侧对话框：
  - 换成 `streaming-markdown` 或 `Incremark`
- WPS 正文：
  - 主路径：`streaming-markdown` 自定义 renderer，边收 chunk 边写 WPS
  - 行内样式：粗体、斜体、代码、链接，下发到刚写入的 Range 上，实时生效
  - 块级样式：标题、引用、列表，实时插入段落和样式
  - 表格/复杂嵌套：
    - 不要整篇重写
    - 只对“最后一个仍在增长的块”用 `PasteHtml` 局部替换

我这里要说明一点，这个是推断结论，不是官方原话：
- “完美实时格式化”在 Markdown 流里本来就不存在绝对完美，因为很多语义要等后续 token 才能最终确定。
- 能做到的是 ChatGPT 那种“乐观实时格式化”：当前看起来已经像标题/粗体/代码块的部分，先按那个样子渲染；后面如果结构变化，只修最后一个活跃块，不回滚整篇。

我建议直接采用这个最终路线：
- `streaming-markdown` 作为唯一解析核心
- 一套 token 流，同时驱动右侧 UI 和 WPS 正文
- 禁止“整篇最终格式化重写”
- 只允许“尾块局部修正”

来源：
- WPS Range: https://solution.wps.cn/docs/client/api/Word/Range.html
- WPS Selection: https://solution.wps.cn/docs/client/api/Word/Selection.html
- WPS Font: https://solution.wps.cn/docs/client/api/Word/Font.html
- WPS ParagraphFormat: https://solution.wps.cn/docs/client/api/Word/ParagraphFormat.html
- WPS 批量插入数据 demo: https://solution.wps.cn/docs/demo/word/bulk-fill-data.html
- streaming-markdown: https://github.com/thetarnav/streaming-markdown
- Streamdown: https://github.com/vercel/streamdown
- Incremark: https://www.incremark.com/
- NLUX markdown: https://www.npmjs.com/package/%40nlux/markdown

如果按这个方向，我下一步就直接把当前项目改成这套。

# Streaming *Markdown*

[![version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/streaming-markdown?logo=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/streaming-markdown) [![github](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-streaming--markdown-orange?logo=github)](https://github.com/thetarnav/streaming-markdown)

**Experiment making a streaming makdown parser *脿 la ChatGPT.***

---

## Installation

Install `streaming-markdown` package from npm.

```bash
npm install streaming-markdown
```

*Or just copy [**`smd.js`**](https://github.com/thetarnav/streaming-markdown/blob/main/smd.js) file to your project.*

Or use the [CDN link](https://www.jsdelivr.com/package/npm/streaming-markdown).\
It's a minified *(3kB Gzip)* version of the package, with only the necessary functions exported.\
See the exports in [`smd_min_entry.js`](https://github.com/thetarnav/streaming-markdown/blob/main/smd_min_entry.js).\
The package uses ES module exports, so you need to use `type="module"` in your script tag.

```html
<script type="module">
    import * as smd from "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/streaming-markdown/smd.min.js"
    // ...
</script>
```

## Usage

First create new markdown `Parser` by calling `parser` function.\
It's single argument is a `Renderer` object, which is an interface to render the parsed markdown tokens to the DOM.\
There are two built-in renderers鈥擿default_renderer` and `logger_renderer`鈥攖hat you can try at first.

```js
import * as smd from "streaming-markdown"

const element  = document.getElementById("markdown")
const renderer = smd.default_renderer(element)
const parser   = smd.parser(renderer)
```

### `write` function

Then, you can start streaming markdown to the `Parser` by calling `parser_write` function with the chunk of markdown string.

```js
smd.parser_write(parser, "# Streaming Markdown\n\n")
```

*You can write **as many times as you want** to stream the markdown.*

The parser is optimistic.
When it sees the start of an inline code block or code block,
it will immediately style the element accordingly.

E.g. `` `print("hello wor `` should be rendered as `<code>print("hello wor</code>`

While the text is streamed in, the user should be able to select the text that has already been streamed in and copy it.
*(The parser is only adding new elements to the DOM, not modifying the existing ones.)*

### `end` function

Finally, you can end the stream by calling `end` function.

It will reset the `Parser` state and flush the remaining markdown.

```js
smd.parser_end(parser)
```

### Renderer interface

| Field name  | Type                   | Description |
| ----------- | ---------------------- | ----------- |
| `data`      | `T`                    | User data object.<br>Available as first param in callbacks. |
| `add_token` | `Renderer_Add_Token<T>`| When the tokens starts. |
| `end_token` | `Renderer_End_Token<T>`| When the token ends. |
| `add_text`  | `Renderer_Add_Text<T>` | To append text to current token.<br>Can be called multiple times or none. |
| `set_attr`  | `Renderer_Set_Attr<T>` | Set additional attributes of current token eg. the link url. |

- [x] Code Block with indent

- [x] *italic* with single asterisks
- [x] **Bold** with double asterisks
- [x] _italic_ with underscores

function compareModelEntries(left, right, currentModel) {

+import {
+  default_renderer,
+  parser as createParser,
+  parser_end,
+  parser_write
+} from "streaming-markdown";
+
+function resetParserState(container, parserRef, renderedRef, endedRef) {
+  container.innerHTML = "";
+  parserRef.current = createParser(default_renderer(container));
+  renderedRef.current = "";
+  endedRef.current = false;
+}
+
+export default function StreamingMarkdown({ content, streaming }) {
+  const containerRef = useRef(null);
+  const parserRef = useRef(null);
+  const renderedContentRef = useRef("");
+  const endedRef = useRef(false);
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    const container = containerRef.current;
+    if (!container) {
+      return;
+    }
+
+    const nextContent = String(content ?? "");
+    if (!parserRef.current) {
+      resetParserState(
+        container,
+        parserRef,
+        renderedContentRef,
+        endedRef
+      );
+    }
+
+    if (!nextContent.startsWith(renderedContentRef.current)) {
+      resetParserState(
+        container,
+        parserRef,
+        renderedContentRef,
+        endedRef
+      );
+    }
+
+    const delta = nextContent.slice(renderedContentRef.current.length);
+    if (delta) {
+      parser_write(parserRef.current, delta);
+      renderedContentRef.current = nextContent;
+    }
+
+    if (!streaming && !endedRef.current) {
+      parser_end(parserRef.current);
+      endedRef.current = true;
+    }
+  }, [content, streaming]);
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    return () => {
+      parserRef.current = null;
+      renderedContentRef.current = "";
+      endedRef.current = false;
+    };
+  }, []);
+
+  if (!content) {
+    return <div className="bubble-placeholder">{streaming ? "..." : ""}</div>;
+  }
+
+  return <div ref={containerRef} className="bubble-markdown" />;

function createModelEntry(item, previous = null) {

function normalizeBenchmark(input) {
  if (!input || typeof input !== "object") {
    return null;
  }

  return {

    firstByteMs: Number.isFinite(Number(input.firstByteMs))

  return (Array.isArray(items) ? items : [])

**Findings**
- 严重：右侧对话框和 WPS 正文现在是两套不同的渲染引擎。右侧用 `StreamingMarkdown` 直接增量渲染 DOM，[App.jsx:804](/D:/cursor_dev/wps_ai/src/taskpane/App.jsx#L804) [StreamingMarkdown.jsx:16](/D:/cursor_dev/wps_ai/src/taskpane/StreamingMarkdown.jsx#L16)；WPS 用另一套手写 token 状态机做格式映射，[wps.js:162](/D:/cursor_dev/wps_ai/src/taskpane/wps.js#L162) [wps.js:299](/D:/cursor_dev/wps_ai/src/taskpane/wps.js#L299) [wps.js:489](/D:/cursor_dev/wps_ai/src/taskpane/wps.js#L489)。这就是“右侧快、正文慢、格式不同步、某些 Markdown 表现不一致”的根因。要做成你要的效果，不应该继续双轨并行。
- 严重：`wps.js` 把 WPS 当成浏览器 DOM 在用，几乎每个小片段都在做 `InsertAfter`、取 `Range`、改 `Font`、改 `ParagraphFormat`。[wps.js:169](/D:/cursor_dev/wps_ai/src/taskpane/wps.js#L169) [wps.js:172](/D:/cursor_dev/wps_ai/src/taskpane/wps.js#L172) [wps.js:175](/D:/cursor_dev/wps_ai/src/taskpane/wps.js#L175) [wps.js:499](/D:/cursor_dev/wps_ai/src/taskpane/wps.js#L499)。这会直接带来卡顿、停顿感、同步漂移，也是最容易出错的部分。当前实现复杂度压错地方了。
- 高：`OpenRouter` 配置在启动时有被 NVIDIA 默认配置覆盖的风险。`App.jsx` 把 `providerId === "openrouter"` 视为“未配置”，然后合并 bootstrap 默认值，[App.jsx:324](/D:/cursor_dev/wps_ai/src/taskpane/App.jsx#L324) [App.jsx:332](/D:/cursor_dev/wps_ai/src/taskpane/App.jsx#L332)；而 relay bootstrap 默认强制是 NVIDIA，[relay.mjs:140](/D:/cursor_dev/wps_ai/server/relay.mjs#L140) [relay.mjs:147](/D:/cursor_dev/wps_ai/server/relay.mjs#L147)。这和“可配置 OpenRouter 或 NVIDIA”这个目标是冲突的。
- 高：上下文没有做任何预算或裁剪，当前是把选区全文直接塞进消息里。[App.jsx:631](/D:/cursor_dev/wps_ai/src/taskpane/App.jsx#L631) [ai.js:380](/D:/cursor_dev/wps_ai/src/taskpane/ai.js#L380)。这不符合你要的“上下文自动调整到最大”，而且大选区会显著拖慢首包，甚至导致请求失败。
- 中：`App.jsx` 已经变成了一个大而全组件，UI、配置、滚动、流式生成、模型测速、弹窗状态都混在一起。[App.jsx:266](/D:/cursor_dev/wps_ai/src/taskpane/App.jsx#L266) [App.jsx:483](/D:/cursor_dev/wps_ai/src/taskpane/App.jsx#L483) [App.jsx:744](/D:/cursor_dev/wps_ai/src/taskpane/App.jsx#L744)。现在还能跑，但后面继续加功能只会越来越脆。
- 中：provider / proxy / timeout / SSE 逻辑被拆在前端和 relay 两边。[ai.js:180](/D:/cursor_dev/wps_ai/src/taskpane/ai.js#L180) [ai.js:405](/D:/cursor_dev/wps_ai/src/taskpane/ai.js#L405) [relay.mjs:567](/D:/cursor_dev/wps_ai/server/relay.mjs#L567)。对你这种“尽量少让用户操作”的产品目标，前端应该更傻，只认本地 relay。
- 低：有清理债务。`startTransition` 未使用，[App.jsx:1](/D:/cursor_dev/wps_ai/src/taskpane/App.jsx#L1)；`markdown.js` 整个未被使用，[markdown.js](/D:/cursor_dev/wps_ai/src/taskpane/markdown.js)；`marked` / `dompurify` 也就成了悬空依赖，[package.json:14](/D:/cursor_dev/wps_ai/package.json#L14)。另外我没找到任何流式解析或 WPS 写入的自动测试。

**结论**
不需要把整个项目推倒重来，但不应该继续沿着现在这套 `wps.js` 渲染方式和 `App.jsx` 组织方式继续堆功能。  
该保留的是：本地 relay、右侧聊天预览、现在这套简洁白色 UI。  
该重写的是：WPS 实时写入核心、流式控制器、配置加载逻辑。

**更简化、也更稳的写法**
1. 前端只连本地 relay。UI 不再直接理解 OpenRouter/NVIDIA 的差异，所有 provider、代理、测速、默认模型都收敛到 relay。
2. 生成时只保留一条流：`chunk -> 单一增量 Markdown 解析器 -> 标准 render ops`。右侧预览和 WPS 都消费同一批 ops，不再各自解析一遍。
3. WPS 实时模式只支持安全子集：段落、标题、列表、加粗、斜体、引用、代码块、换行。表格、任务列表、复杂嵌套先降级成纯文本或块结束后再补样式。不要追求把 WPS 做成第二个浏览器。
4. WPS 写入改成“批量插入 + 闭合后着色”。也就是先按 30-80ms 或按块批量写文字，等一个段落或一对 `**` / `*` 闭合后，再对那个范围应用格式。这仍然是实时格式化，但比现在的逐 token 改字体稳定得多。
5. `App.jsx` 拆成 `AppShell`、`useChatController`、`SettingsModal`、`ModelLabModal`。主页面只管显示，流式、选区、停止、错误处理全部进 controller。

**补充**
`npm run build` 现在是通过的，但这只能说明能打包，不说明运行期这套架构足够稳。  
如果按你的目标继续做，我的判断是：下一步不该继续修补现有 `wps.js`，而是直接把“单流控制器 + 单解析器 + 简化 WPS live writer”这一层重做。
